title: Data Architect (Database Administration & Optimization)
description:
You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. You enjoy working close to the database layer and understanding how architectural decisions directly impact performance, scalability, and reliability. You are comfortable owning data architecture decisions end to end and thrive in environments where deep technical expertise, autonomy, and collaboration with engineering teams are essential.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.

  • Hands-on experience designing and operating data solutions on AWS, with strong preference for RDS and Aurora.
  • Advanced expertise in SQL, including complex query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure development.
  • Deep understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, and I/O constraints impact database and data architecture performance.
  • Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance.
  • Strong proficiency using GitHub for version control, collaboration, and documentation.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of architectural decisions, and drive improvements end to end.

  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and system performance.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with distributed and US-based teams.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, evolve, and maintain data architectures that prioritize performance, scalability, and reliability on AWS RDS and Aurora.
  • Analyze and optimize database workloads through SQL performance tuning, query refactoring, and advanced indexing strategies.
  • Identify architectural and infrastructure-level bottlenecks related to CPU, memory, storage, and I/O, proposing scalable solutions.
  • Define and enforce data modeling and architectural standards for high-performance transactional and analytical workloads.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers and technical teams to ensure strong alignment between application and data layers.
  • Establish and promote best practices for database performance monitoring, optimization, and reliability across environments.
  • Review and optimize stored procedures and complex SQL logic from an architectural and performance perspective.
  • Document data architecture decisions, performance guidelines, and optimization strategies.
  • Act as a technical reference and advisor for data architecture and performance topics across teams.
  • Support technical discussions with stakeholders by providing clear recommendations and trade-off analyses.

Additional Information

About Us

We Are Engineered Different.

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Sr. Product Manager, Growth (NGL) (Remote)
description:
Who We Are

Mode Mobile builds apps that reward users for engaging with content, entertainment, games, and communities they love. Our portfolio includes category-defining products with millions of users globally, scaling rapidly through organic growth and strategic acquisitions.

You will be joining NGL ("Not Gonna Lie") , one of the most viral social apps in recent years, with 144M+ monthly users across web and mobile. NGL provides a safe, curious, and authentic space for people to connect through anonymous messaging and self-expression.

Now part of Mode Mobile's portfolio, NGL is entering its next phase of explosive growth, including expanded monetization, creative experimentation, and scaled user acquisition initiatives.

The Mission

Own and scale NGL's revenue, funnels, and lifecycle growth by turning traffic into durable, monetizable user behavior. You will run growth as a system…from acquisition through retention…while protecting the viral mechanics that make NGL work.

This role is measured in metrics shipped , not features shipped.

Our Team and Culture Drive Our Success

Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, and curiosity, with a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster a culture of open communication and transparency. We are driven and hard‑working but also committed to having fun along the way. We allow OKRs to guide us, assume positive intent, sometimes agree to disagree and commit, honor our commitments, seek to accomplish more with less, and encourage everyone to speak up as our team owns our company's success.

You can read more about our team and how we work here.

The Role

This role reports directly to the General Manager – NGL and operates as the single‑threaded owner of growth and monetization for the product. You will work cross‑functionally with Monetization, Paid UA, Engineering, Design, and Data , and you will own feature rollout end‑to‑end in partnership with Engineering.

What You’ll Do

  • Monetization Systems
    • You own all product‑led revenue systems:
      • Subscription pricing, tiers, and trials
      • Optimize onboarding and paywall timing by traffic source
      • One‑time purchases (reveals, hints, boosts)
      • Paywall timing, copy, UX, and placement
      • Revenue per active user (ARPDAU / ARPU)
      • Monetization performance by cohort (influencer, paid UA, organic)
      • Extensive collaboration with Monetization Team by translating revenue strategy into shipped product features
    • You are accountable for revenue lift without growth decay.
  • Organic Funnels, Influencer & Creator Funnels
    • NGL is creator‑driven. You own:
      • Influencer onboarding flows
      • Creator‑specific product surfaces and incentives
      • Conversion paths from influencer posts → installs → paid actions
      • Monetization differences by creator tier and audience quality
      • Feedback loops that increase creator posting frequency and retention
    • Partnerships source creators. Product owns the funnel.
  • Funnel Ownership (End‑to‑End)
    • You own the full lifecycle:
      • Entry (Snap, IG, TikTok, deep links)
      • First‑session experience and activation
      • Message reveal mechanics and engagement triggers
      • Re‑engagement loops (notifications, prompts, scarcity)
      • Conversion to paid
      • Design funnels that improve LTV and payback
      • Retention, churn reduction, and win‑back flows
    • You are expected to know where every drop‑off lives.
  • Experimentation & Growth Velocity
    • You will:
      • Maintain a prioritized growth experiment backlog
      • Run continuous A/B tests across onboarding, pricing, and UX
      • Test influencer‑specific monetization strategies
      • Kill underperforming ideas quickly
      • Scale winners aggressively
      • K‑Factor Optimization
    • Speed and learning rate matter more than perfection.
  • Feature Ownership & Rollout (Engineering)
    • You own feature execution end‑to‑end:
      • Write clear PRDs tied to growth and revenue outcomes
      • Prioritize engineering work based on expected impact
      • Partner with engineering to ship experiments quickly
      • Own rollout plans, gating, and ramp strategies
      • Monitor post‑launch performance and iterate fast
    • You ship, measure, and refine. No throw‑it‑over‑the‑wall handoffs.
  • Reporting, Dashboards & GM Updates
    • You will:
      • Build and maintain clear growth dashboards
      • Report weekly to the NGL GM on:
        • Revenue performance
        • Funnel metrics
        • Experiment results
        • Key risks and opportunities
        • Provide data‑backed recommendations for roadmap and spend decisions
      • The GM should never be surprised by the numbers

Success in This Role Means

  • You are directly accountable for:
    • Paid conversion rate
    • ARPU / LTV
    • D7 / D30 retention
    • Revenue by acquisition source
    • LTV / CAC and payback period
    • Experiment velocity

What You Bring to the Team

  • 5–8+ years of experience in Growth Product, Monetization, or Lifecycle Product roles within consumer mobile apps, with clear ownership of revenue and growth outcomes
  • Direct ownership of core metrics such as ARPDAU, ARPU, LTV, conversion rate, retention, and payback
  • Experience scaling subscription and hybrid monetization models, including subscriptions and one‑time purchases
  • Experience owning pricing strategy, paywalls, onboarding optimization, and revenue performance by cohort
  • Strong data fluency, including cohort analysis, funnel diagnostics, and payback modeling
  • Proven track record running high‑velocity A/B testing and maintaining a structured experimentation backlog
  • Demonstrated success improving acquisition, activation, monetization, and retention through measurable experimentation
  • Experience partnering closely with Engineering to ship growth and monetization features end‑to‑end
  • Experience working cross‑functionally with UA, Monetization, Design, and Data teams
  • Comfort operating as the accountable owner of revenue impact
  • A systems mindset that prioritizes measurable outcomes over feature output
  • Ability to move quickly, make decisions with imperfect information, and balance aggressive growth optimization with protecting product integrity and viral mechanics
  • Experience in creator‑driven or social products preferred
  • Experience optimizing K‑Factor and viral loops preferred
  • Experience working with Snap, Instagram, or TikTok acquisition funnels preferred
  • Alignment with our core values:
    • Accountable: You take ownership of your responsibilities, demonstrating trustworthiness and self‑discipline. You are consistent in your work, transparent in your actions, and communicate effectively. You follow through on commitments and strive for continuous improvement.
    • Action‑driven: Identify what is most important, agree on scope, execute in a timely manner, and drive the greatest impact. You take initiative, roll up your sleeves, and get things done.
    • Caring: You genuinely care about yourself and others, our business and craft, our mission and vision, and are passionate in heart and mind. You understand the importance of our team and strive to create a positive, supportive work environment.
    • Curious: You focus on the 'why,' learn and expand your knowledge, explore new ideas, and generally make things better. You're a lifelong learner with a thirst for knowledge and a constant desire to improve.
    • Thorough: Your work is thoughtful, impactful, timely, accurate, and complete. You pay attention to detail, are meticulous, and ensure quality work and compliance.

Why Join Mode Mobile

  • Be part of a company where the culture is the magic . Our team consistently says the best part of Mode is the people – collaborative, humble, hungry, and genuinely invested in each other's success.
  • Make an impact on millions of users across a global social platform with massive scale and cultural relevance.
  • Work with a global, top‑tier engineering team that cares deeply about craftsmanship, velocity, and helping each other win.
  • Shape the next stage of a high‑growth social platform , entering an exciting next phase of growth, scale, and innovation.
  • Join a mission‑driven culture where ownership is real, ideas travel fast, and your work has a visible impact.
  • Grow inside a fast‑growing, post‑acquisition business backed by strong leadership and investment in monetization, UA, and product innovation.
  • Work fully remote with a globally distributed team that values autonomy, trust, and transparent collaboration.

We Believe in the Following Workplace Norms

  • Allow OKRs to Guide Us
  • Assume Positive Intent
  • Agree to Disagree & Commit
  • Set New Precedents
  • Accomplish More with Less
  • Hold Yourself & Others to High Standards
  • Speak Up
  • Be Resourceful
  • Follow the 80/20 Rule

What We Are Offering

  • We are a 100% remote‑first, global company.
  • A competitive compensation package.
  • We offer generous perks & benefits to team members.
  • Participation in the Company's equity plan (for full‑time team members).
  • We provide individual bonuses in accordance with our Company Bonus Program.
  • Work with energetic, passionate, and results‑driven people.
  • Celebrate team members' personal and work milestones.
  • Remote social activities, including virtual coffee buddies.
  • Bonusly – We use Bonusly as a way to recognize and reward team members for their hard work and commitment.
  • Weekly Wednesday Get Stuff Done Days (No Meetings).
  • Open PTO, generous Company Holidays, and Wellness Days (for full‑time team members).

If we just described you and your perfect role, we'd love to talk with you. We have a lot to accomplish this year and look forward to making headway and creating success together!

title: OPERADOR(A) LOGISTICA I
description:
Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações. Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais. Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. As ações da Gerdau estão listadas nas bolsas de valores de São Paulo (B3) e Nova Iorque (NYSE).

Estamos em busca de um Operador de Logística altamente motivado e dedicado para se juntar à nossa equipe dinâmica. O candidato ideal será responsável por executar diversas tarefas relacionadas à logística, incluindo recebimento, armazenamento, preparação e expedição de produtos. Buscamos alguém com habilidades organizacionais excepcionais, capacidade de trabalho em equipe e atenção aos detalhes para garantir a eficiência e a precisão de nossas operações logísticas.

Responsabilidades

  • Receber, conferir e registrar produtos conforme os procedimentos estabelecidos.
  • Armazenar e organizar produtos em locais designados, garantindo o uso eficiente do espaço e a preservação da integridade dos itens.
  • Preparar pedidos de acordo com as especificações do cliente, utilizando equipamentos de movimentação de carga, como empilhadeiras ou paleteiras.
  • Realizar a expedição de produtos, preparando documentação necessária, como notas fiscais e ordens de entrega.
  • Monitorar e controlar os níveis de estoque, realizando inventários periódicos e identificando possíveis discrepâncias.
  • Colaborar com outros membros da equipe para garantir a eficiência das operações logísticas e o cumprimento dos prazos de entrega.
  • Seguir rigorosamente os procedimentos de segurança e higiene no trabalho, garantindo um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todos os colaboradores.
  • Manter a área de trabalho limpa, organizada e livre de obstruções, conforme os padrões de segurança e qualidade.

OBS: Carteira de habilitação é necessário

Temos como princípio a promoção de um ambiente diverso e inclusivo. Respeitamos e valorizamos a diversidade, por isso todas as pessoas qualificadas serão consideradas para as vagas sem distinção de deficiência, gênero, idade, identidade ou orientação sexual, nacionalidade, raça, religião, ou qualquer outra característica.

title: Coordenador de PCM
description:
Descrição da vaga

Sobre a vaga

NaM. Dias Branco, acreditamos que a qualidade de vida no trabalho e o desenvolvimento das pessoas são essenciais para o nosso sucesso. Por isso, investimos em treinamentos, bem-estar e um ambiente colaborativo, onde cada pessoa é valorizada. Quer crescer com a gente? Vem!

Quem somos

Somos uma das maiores indústrias de alimentos do Brasil, líderes em massas e biscoitos, com mais de 70 anos de história. Marcas como Piraquê, Fit Food, Adria, Jasmine, Frontera, Vitarella, Isabela, Fortaleza, Richester, Puro Sabor, Finna e muitas outras fazem parte da vida de milhões de brasileiros. Temos mais de 17 mil colaboradores, 21 unidades no Brasil, 1 no Uruguai e 28 centros de distribuição, que garantem nossa presença no Brasil e em mais de 40 países pelo mundo.

Nossa atuação e cultura

Atuamos em diversos segmentos de alimentos, com um portfólio que inclui biscoitos, massas, farinhas, margarinas, bolos, snacks, torradas, chocolates, temperos, molhos, granolas, cookies, pasta de amendoim, panificação sem glúten e beneficiamento de grãos.

Valorizamos o respeito às pessoas e à diversidade, por acreditarmos que ela impulsiona resultados e transformações. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, onde todos são respeitados e reconhecidos por sua autenticidade e potencial, independentemente de idade, gênero, etnia ou orientação sexual.

Missão do Cargo:

Coordenar o acompanhamento, controle e execução das atividades do plano de manutenção de equipamentos e instalações, assegurando o melhor desempenho operacional, a redução de perdas por paradas produtivas e a melhoria contínua dos processos, visando otimização de custos e aumento da confiabilidade dos ativos. Além disso, garantir a gestão eficiente do almoxarifado de peças e materiais de manutenção, assegurando disponibilidade, inventários, organização e controle dos estoques, contribuindo diretamente para a eficácia da manutenção preventiva e o pleno funcionamento das operações.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Seus desafios serão:

  • Liderar o cumprimento das atividades de manutenção planejada através do desdobramento das metas de planejamento a toda equipe de manutenção industrial visando otimizar a execução dessas atividades bem como a melhor disponibilidade dos equipamentos;
  • Planejar custos de projetos relacionados as áreas de manutenção das unidades da empresa, visando o atendimento dos prazos planejados e o orçamento previsto;
  • Planejar e cumprir as diretrizes vigentes para a gestão de despesas na manutenção e capital empregado, através da otimização dos recursos, visando reduzir tanto a despesa quanto a estrutura de custos a patamares competitivos;
  • Aprovar e revisar os procedimentos de manutenção, de forma clara e objetiva, padronizando e organizando os processos de manutenção, de maneira a estabelecer a sinergia entre todos os setores;
  • Coordenar a execução do orçamento anual, através do acompanhamento do cumprimento das manutenções preventivas e apoio em projetos;
  • Cumprir os requisitos de sustentabilidade, gestão da qualidade, segurança de alimentos, meio ambiente e segurança e saúde ocupacional.
  • Garantir a disponibilidade de peças e materiais críticos, por meio de gestão eficiente de estoque, análises de criticidade, giro e curva ABC, evitando paradas por falta de componentes;
  • Reduzir custos de estoque, atuando sobre obsolescência, estoque parado;
  • Elevar a acuracidade do almoxarifado, através de controles rígidos de entrada, saída, devolução, inventários e rastreabilidade de peças;
  • Padronizar e organizar o almoxarifado técnico, assegurando correta catalogação, identificação e armazenamento dos materiais;
  • Integrar almoxarifado e PCM, garantindo que as demandas de manutenção preventiva e corretiva estejam alinhadas ao planejamento de materiais;
  • Aumentar a efetividade dos planos de manutenção preventiva, revisando periodicamente frequências, escopos e metodologias com base em dados de desempenho e falhas;
  • Elevar o índice de cumprimento da manutenção preventiva, garantindo execução dentro dos prazos planejados e reduzindo intervenções não programadas;
  • Integrar ferramentas preditivas (vibração, termografia, lubrificação etc.) para aprimorar o planejamento e reduzir falhas recorrentes;
  • Reduzir quebras e intervenções corretivas de emergência, através da melhoria contínua do plano preventivo e da análise sistêmica de falhas;
  • Aprimorar a confiabilidade dos ativos, garantindo que as ações preventivas estejam alinhadas à criticidade dos equipamentos e aos objetivos operacionais;

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Superior completo;
  • Desejável pós-graduação completa;
  • No mínimo 6 meses de experiência na área ou áreas correlatas

Será um diferencial se:

  • Pacote Office, Curso PCM (Planejamento e controle da Manutenção), gestão de pessoas, gestão de projetos (EAP, Project e etc), Técnicas Preditiva (Vibração, Termografia e etc), ferramentas de gestão e análise de falhas (FMEA, FTA, Reengenharia) e ferramentas de gestão.

title: Investment Director Climate Investor 2
description:
Climate Fund Managers B.V. (CFM) is a leading blended finance fund manager dedicated to securing a sustainable future by investing across global emerging markets. CFM has a long-term vision to structure cutting edge financing facilities around thematic areas of climate change mitigation and adaptation, including renewable energy, water and oceans, sustainable land use, and sustainable cities. CFM is established as a joint venture between the Dutch development bank FMO and Sanlam InfraWorks – part of the Sanlam Group of South Africa with offices in The Hague, Cape Town, Windhoek, Singapore and Bogota.

CFM is subject to supervision by the Dutch Authority for the Financial Markets (Autoriteit Financiële Markten or “AFM”) and/or the Dutch Central Bank (De Nederlandsche Bank N.V. or “DNB”) and is authorised to act as investment manager (beheerder ).

Job Purpose

We are seeking an Investment Director to strengthen our Investments and Asset Management team. This role will report to the Regional Head of Latin America and will be ideally based in Brazil (Sao Paulo (preferred) or Rio de Janeiro). The Investment Director will interface CFM divisions and offices.

As a leader in the sustainable finance sector and a pioneer in the renewable energy, water sanitation, oceans infrastructure and green hydrogen sectors, CFM is committed to driving positive environmental impact through strategic investments in climate-related projects. The Investment Director will play a pivotal role in originating and executing on our investment strategies, managing a portfolio of water sanitation, waste valorisation opportunities and oceans infrastructure assets, contributing to the transformation of the LatAm economy and the transition to a more sustainable future.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Management and execution of CI-2 / Climate Investor Two Fund Managers Investment and Fundraising Strategy: Originate investment opportunities that align with the fund’s climate objectives, with a particular emphasis on all themes relevant in the Brazilian market that are in alignment with the CI2 mandate primarily namely water sanitation, waste transformation and oceans infrastructure projects in LatAm, taking into consideration ESG factors and the potential for positive environmental impact.
  • Portfolio Management: Invest and manage a diverse portfolio of water and sanitation and oceans infrastructure assets with a focus on strategic projects to CFM in Brazil.
  • Due Diligence: Conduct thorough due diligence on potential investment opportunities, assessing financial viability, evaluating technology readiness, environmental sustainability, market potential and key risk factors, supported by the regional Latam team.
  • Deal Structuring: Collaborate with the broader investment team to structure deals, negotiate terms, and secure financing for water, sanitation and oceans infrastructure projects in LatAm.
  • Risk Management: Monitor and mitigate risks associated with water, sanitation and oceans infrastructure investments, implementing strategies to preserve capital and maximize returns.
  • Impact Measurement: Maintain robust impact measurement frameworks to track and report on the environmental benefits of investments.
  • Stakeholder Relations: Foster strong relationships with project developers, partners, and stakeholders in the water, sanitation, and oceans infrastructure ecosystem.
  • Compliance: Ensure investments are compliant with all regulatory and ethical guidelines, staying up to date with relevant regulations and industry standards.
  • Fundraising and growth opportunities: Identify and highlight opportunities to seek new capital investors that may align with CFM’s products and growth strategies and support any such initiatives as requested.
  • Team Management: Provide management, mentorship, and guidance to junior investment professionals, promoting a collaborative and growth-oriented work environment as it may be relevant, while interacting closely with other Latam team members based in the region.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Chartered Accountant, CFA or Engineer with MBA or equivalent master’s degree.
  • A minimum of 15‑years of experience in investment banking, corporate finance with a strong track record in deal structuring and financial reporting in the Renewable Energy, Water, Waste to Energy and Oceans Infrastructure sector.
  • Strong analytical, communication and negotiation abilities.
  • English and Spanish language proficiency in addition to native Portuguese.
  • Proven ability to work across technical/financial and legal aspects of a transaction and work with various specialists internally and with government/shareholder/lender type stakeholders to provide transaction leadership.
  • Knowledge of relevant regulations and ESG Principles, compliance requirements, including but not limited to IFRS standards.
  • Ability to plan and prioritise effectively: strong project / process and team management skills.
  • Ability to apply sound business judgment and an analytical, pragmatic, and creative approach to problem solving.
  • Technically proficient (Advanced) in Excel, Word, PowerPoint essential.
  • Experience and significant proven track record of working in Brazil and other LatAm jurisdictions.
  • Work permit and residency in Brazil.

Behavioural Competencies

  • Result-oriented – Being focused on achieving objectives and results, persevering in the face of adversity.
  • Devotion to quality – Demanding a high quality on outputs and acting accordingly.
  • Planning – Systematically organizing activities and setting time frames, setting priorities.
  • Initiative – Identifying opportunities or solutions, and taking action.
  • Analysing and forming opinions – Being focused on examining matters in a systematic way.
  • Cooperation – Working with others in order to effectively contribute to a common objective.
  • Situational Awareness – Being well informed about developments in one's environment and effectively using this information for one's own organisation.
  • Performance under pressure – Maintaining an effective performance under pressure, or when faced with setbacks or disappointment.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.

What You Can Expect

The Associate Director & Counsel, Global Compliance Investigations, will be responsible for conducting confidential internal investigations on behalf of Zimmer Biomet. This position will report to the Director & Senior Counsel - Americas, Global Compliance Investigations (“GCI”), and will be responsible for investigations in the Latin America (LatAm) region. He/she will work closely and collaboratively with legal and compliance team members in the global and LatAm regional offices, manage outside counsel, as well as external investigation-related vendors and consultants.

How You'll Create Impact

Global Compliance Investigations

  • Evaluate and manage hotline and non-hotline complaints and other potential compliance issues, including assessing the matter upfront, triaging matters to the appropriate team member or function, and developing work plans for items handled by the global compliance investigations team.
  • Leverage other investigation resources as needed, as well as developing findings and memorializing these efforts and final conclusions.
  • Engage and oversee outside counsel, including regular contact with outside counsel, auditors, consultants and vendors.
  • Work with the Director & Senior Counsel – Americas, GCI, to prepare and present findings of all investigations to relevant disciplinary committees and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Work with the Director & Senior Counsel – Americas, GCI, to provide regular updates on investigations and findings to the Vice President, Global Compliance Investigations, Chief Compliance Officer, General Counsel, and other senior leadership as appropriate.

Other

  • Actively monitor developments related to compliance, anticorruption enforcement, and other compliance-related matters, discussing with team members and drafting summaries/updates for external stakeholders.
  • Analyze investigative trends and update relevant stakeholders in the region.
  • Remain up-to-date on relevant trends and activities in the global compliance sphere within the life sciences industry.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize multiple tasks.

  • Ability to communicate effectively to a diverse audience at multiple levels within the company through various formats.
  • Excellent note‑taking skills.
  • Familiarity with forensic accounting, US GAAP, and payment systems (such as SAP) a plus.
  • Must be fluent in English and Spanish; Portuguese language skills a plus.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

Your Background

  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience, with a strong preference for experience with compliance and conducting internal investigations, including FCPA‑related investigations, ideally for multinational companies in the health care/life sciences industry.

title: Amxl Operations
description:
DESCRIPTION

Our logistics teams are transforming the way we interact with customers around the world, every day, and solving some of the biggest logistics challenges faced not only by Amazon, but by the entire industry. Whether items are large or small, we develop solutions to ensure that we deliver on our promise to the customer.

Amazon Logistics Brazil (AMZL) is looking for a Logistics Operations Specialist to join the AMXL (logistics operations for large items) team. This person will be the focal point for operational activities carried out by third‑party partners. The operations take place 7 days a week, including holidays, with a 4x3 scale, distributed between front and back office teams.

The professional will be responsible for managing delivery stations operated by external logistics partners, ensuring the performance, compliance, and standardization of processes. It will play a fundamental role in tactical execution aimed at growth, expansion and maintenance of quality and operational excellence.

You will work in a highly collaborative, dynamic and fast‑paced environment — closer to a start‑up than to a large corporation. We adopt the mindset that no idea is bad and that the best ideas should be tested and tried.

It is essential that this person is able to thrive in an ambiguous and fast environment, delivering consistent results. Some of the activities will be carried out remotely, while others will include audits and in‑person visits to the logistics partners' operations.

Key job responsibilities

  • Manage end‑to‑end the stations operated by logistics partners, ensuring efficiency, compliance, safety and the best customer experience.
  • Act operationally in managing the daily routine, ensuring the execution of processes, volume monitoring, and resolution of deviations.
  • Monitor and optimize operating costs, identifying opportunities to reduce expenses and increase productivity without compromising quality.
  • Manage operational capacity, anticipating peaks in demand and ensuring adequate resources, infrastructure, and teams for current and future volumes.
  • Develop, implement, and lead tactical and expansion projects, such as network adjustments and optimization of logistics flows.
  • Define and monitor strategic metrics and KPIs with logistics partners, implementing action plans to achieve or exceed goals.
  • Analyze data from multiple sources to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, using insights for critical and quick decisions.
  • Act as the main link between internal and external stakeholders, ensuring alignment of objectives, deadlines, and compliance.

A day in the life

The Logistics Operations Specialist manages the operation of outsourced delivery stations, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and quality. It acts both tactically, analyzing metrics, and operationally, following the daily routine and resolving deviations on the ground. It works in collaboration with internal teams such as Planning, Security and Supply Chain, as well as external partners. It is responsible for ensuring adequate capacity for peak demand and presenting business cases for improvements. The focus is on ensuring that large items are delivered with speed and excellence, ensuring the best customer experience.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience managing large data sets and utilizing to drive performance and process improvements
  • Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)
  • Experience in program management, logistics, operations, supply chain, transportation, or equivalent
  • English Skills

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with SQL

Basic Function

Full‑time laboratory research position in Alzheimer’s disease and related dementia (ADRD). Key responsibilities include:

  • Conduct experiments utilizing various techniques specific to the laboratory to investigate mechanisms and treatment strategies of ADRD. Maintain detailed and accurate records of experimental procedures and results.
  • Collect, maintain, analyze, and interpret experimental data using appropriate statistical and analytical methods. Contribute to the preparation of research presentations and manuscripts.
  • Participate in lab meeting seminars, and collaborative research discussions.
  • Assist with general lab maintenance and organization, including ordering supplies and ensuring compliance with safety regulations.

Supervisory Authority

Host laboratory mentors and program leadership provide supervisory authority for HU-ERA-PREP Scholars. Fellows will report to assigned research mentors at host labs, who will provide direct oversight, mentorship and project management including ensuring accurate documentation and presentation of research activities and findings. Research supervisors will enforce compliance with institutional policies ethical guidelines and safety regulations. Regular performance evaluations will be conducted to provide constructive feedback, identify areas for improvement as well as recognize exceptional performance and contributions.

Nature And Scope

Fellows will engage in advanced research focused on mechanisms underlying Alzheimer’s disease or related dementias including preventative and treatment strategies. This position offers a unique opportunity for recent graduates to gain hands‑on research experience and contribute to high‑impact projects in a collaborative and supportive environment.

Principal Accountabilities

Postbaccalaureate Research Fellows in Alzheimer’s disease research, will play a critical role in advancing understanding of the mechanisms underlying this complex neurological disorder. In addition to basic research functions, fellows are expected to:

  • Work collaboratively with principal investigators, postdoctoral fellows and other research staff including assisting in mentoring and training junior lab members.
  • Engage in continuous learning by staying current with relevant advances in the field. Attend workshops, seminars, and conferences to enhance skills and knowledge.
  • Seek feedback and opportunities for growth in research practices and methodologies.

Core Competencies

  • Previous research experience is preferred but not required.
  • Data analysis capabilities, proficiency in using analytical software.
  • Attention to detail and meticulous record‑keeping.
  • Willingness to learn new techniques and adapt to evolving research needs.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with diverse individuals and foster a cooperative lab environment.
  • Commitment to ethical research practices and adherence to institutional and regulatory guidelines.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in a related field (e.g., biology, neuroscience, psychology, biomedical sciences, biomedical engineering). Received a Bachelor’s degree within the past two years. Strong academic record with a 3.2 minimum GPA. Desire to pursue a research‑focused career in Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias. Prior biomedical research experience preferred but not required.

title: Chief Information Security Officer
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) is a senior‑level executive responsible for establishing and maintaining the enterprise vision, strategy, and program to ensure information assets and technologies are adequately protected. This role reports to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) and/or Board of Directors and is critical in managing the information security risk across both the Academic/Research and Clinical/Patient Care domains of the combined institution.

Supervisory Authority

The CISO holds overarching responsibility for the institution’s information security framework. The CISO directly supervises the information security team, including managers, analysts, and technical specialists, and provides guidance to IT and operational departments on security matters. The CISO has the authority to make decisions regarding policies, procedures, and resource allocation within the information security program. This role also collaborates with other department heads and external partners to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards.

Nature And Scope

The CISO operates at the executive level, reporting to the CEO and/or the Board of Directors. The scope of this position covers both Academic/Research and Clinical/Patient Care domains, ensuring that the institution’s information assets and technologies are adequately protected. The CISO is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining a comprehensive information security strategy that aligns with the organization’s overall mission and goals. This includes risk assessment, policy development, security awareness training, incident response, and compliance management. The CISO works closely with senior leadership, legal, compliance, and technology teams to manage security risk and respond effectively to threats in a complex and dynamic environment.

Principal Accountabilities

Strategy and Leadership

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive, long‑term information security strategy and roadmap aligned with the business goals, academic mission, and patient care objectives of both the university and hospital.
  • Lead the security organization, providing mentorship, guidance, and training to security staff and cross‑functional teams.
  • Establish security governance frameworks, policies, and standards to ensure effective risk management and compliance.
  • Manage the information security budget and procurement of necessary security technologies and services.

Risk Management and Compliance

  • Oversee all security risk assessments and audits, ensuring timely remediation of identified vulnerabilities.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and standards, including but not limited to:
    • Healthcare (Hospital Focus): HIPAA/HITECH (Privacy and Security Rules), CMS (Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services) requirements, and relevant state‑specific healthcare data regulations.
    • Higher Education/Research (University Focus): FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act), NIST SP 800‑171 (for controlled unclassified information/research), and PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard) for handling student payments and donations.
  • Manage the incident response program, including planning, testing, and leading the response to significant security breaches or incidents across both institutional environments.

Operational Security

  • Direct the selection, implementation, and maintenance of security systems and tools (e.g., SIEM, firewalls, IDS/IPS, endpoint protection, etc.).
  • Oversee the vulnerability management, penetration testing, and security monitoring programs.
  • Collaborate with IT and Engineering teams to integrate security by design into all new systems, research projects, and clinical technologies.

Communication and Training

  • Serve as the primary spokesperson for information security matters to senior leadership, the Board, faculty, staff, students, and patients.
  • Develop and manage institution‑wide security awareness and training programs tailored to the unique risks and requirements of clinicians, researchers, and students.
  • Report on the security posture and significant risk exposures to executive management and the Board of Directors on a regular basis.

Core Competencies

  • Expert Knowledge of enterprise security architecture, network security, cloud security, and risk assessment methodologies.
  • In‑depth understanding of security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across all levels of a complex organization (clinical, academic, administrative).
  • Proven ability to manage crises and lead an effective security incident response team.
  • A strong record of implementing pragmatic and effective security solutions in environments with competing priorities (e.g., open research vs. strict patient data protection).

Minimum Requirements

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. Master’s degree preferred.
  • Experience: Minimum of 10+ years of progressive experience in information security, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role (e.g., CISO, VP of Security).
  • Dual‑Sector Knowledge: Demonstrated experience or deep understanding of the regulatory and security challenges in both the healthcare and higher education/research sectors is mandatory.

Certifications (One Or More Required)

  • CISSP, CISM, or similar relevant certifications.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Salary Range: $230,000 - $250,000

Job Description

VOTRE MISSION

Le General Manager H/F est responsable du pilotage global de sa Business Unit. Il/Elle garantit la performance commerciale, opérationnelle et financière, le management des équipes locales et la bonne exécution de la stratégie du groupe. Il incarne la vision du groupe et veille au respect des standards de qualité, des valeurs et de la culture de l'entreprise. La maîtrise du français et du portugais est obligatoire pour postuler.

CE QUE VOUS FEREZ

ADMINISTRATION & LÉGAL

MANAGEMENT

  • Application et déploiement des process et décisions stratégiques du groupe
  • Développement d'une culture d'entreprise forte, axée sur la cohésion et l'excellence du service

VENTES & DÉVELOPPEMENT COMMERCIAL

  • Définition des objectifs annuels et mensuels par destination
  • Suivi des ventes, des marges et mise en place d'actions correctives
  • Supervision des devis et validation des cotations complexes
  • Support aux Sales Managers lors de négociations clés et partenariats stratégiques
  • Amélioration continue de la qualité des voyages et de l'expérience client

OPÉRATIONNEL

  • Supervision des opérations et du bon déroulement des voyages
  • Gestion des situations critiques et litiges 24/7
  • Coordination des paiements prestataires avec les équipes Ops
  • Arbitrage entre qualité, délais et coûts
  • Optimisation continue des process opérationnels en lien avec la Finance

FINANCE & REPORTING

  • Élaboration et suivi des budgets annuels
  • Suivi mensuel du chiffre d'affaires, des marges et de la rentabilité

PRODUCTION

  • Supervision de la création de nouveaux produits, itinéraires et expériences
  • Gestion et animation des relations fournisseurs
  • Développement de nouveaux partenariats locaux
  • Veille et benchmark régulier pour assurer compétitivité et différenciation des offres

RSE & TOURISME DURABLE

  • Pilotage du maintien et renouvellement de la certification Travelife
  • Sensibilisation et mobilisation des équipes sur les enjeux RSE
  • Suivi et reporting des KPIs RSE (procédures, conformité, actions mises en place)

VOS INDICATEURS DE PERFORMANCE (KPIs)

Critères quantitatifs

  • Taux de rotation des membres de l'équipe : max 20% / an
  • Taux de marge par dossier (POF réalisés et réservés vs objectifs annuels)

  • Taux de satisfaction client global : ≥ 9/10

Critères qualitatifs

  • Vision stratégique et pilotage : capacité à définir, communiquer et déployer une stratégie claire alignée avec les objectifs du groupe.
  • Excellence opérationnelle & discipline financière : capacité à garantir une exécution fluide, maîtriser les coûts et sécuriser les marges.
  • Représentation & valeurs (incluant RSE) : capacité à représenter le groupe avec crédibilité et à incarner la culture et les engagements du groupe.

Profile / Requirements

  • Vous maîtrisez impérativement le français, le portugais et l'anglais.
  • Issu(e) d'une expérience dans le secteur du voyage, du tourisme ou de l'hôtellerie,

Benefits

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

Role

Canonical is looking for a creative and data-driven Marketing Manager to lead marketing initiatives that generate awareness, engagement, and pipeline for our products. This role blends strategy with hands‑on execution, from crafting compelling campaigns and driving demand generation, to collaborating cross‑functionally with Sales, SDRs, Product, Communications, and Alliances.

As a key contributor to our marketing team, you'll take ownership of high‑impact programs including integrated campaigns, product launches, events, and account‑based marketing. You'll play a pivotal role in connecting our products with the right audiences whether enterprise customers, developers, or strategic partners.

You thrive in fast‑paced environments, love experimenting and optimizing based on data. You are passionate about technology, marketing and the use of technology in marketing. You bring curiosity, ownership, and a strong desire to make things better for your campaigns, your team, and your own growth. If you enjoy building smart, scalable marketing engines with a bit of creative flair, we'd love to hear from you.

Location

Remote, EMEA

What your day will look like

  • Own end‑to‑end go‑to‑market planning and campaign execution across portfolios, territory or vertical.
  • Develop and lead marketing programs that engage with prospects to drive opportunities and revenue.
  • Collaborate closely with other marketing teams to improve content performance and conversion through data‑driven insights.
  • Partner with events, content, paid media, and social media teams to execute integrated campaigns across channels.

What we are looking for in you

  • Experience in a marketing role in the technology sector (SaaS or enterprise IT preferred).
  • Data‑driven mindset with the ability to evaluate performance and optimize for impact.
  • Comfortable balancing strategy with hands‑on execution, a true self‑starter.
  • Strong storytelling skills—you know how to craft messaging that resonates with both technical and business audiences.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Adaptable, fast learner with a growth mindset and a passion for innovation.

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.

  • Fully remote working environment – we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at sprints
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote‑first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st‑century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Remote AI Agent Specialist (Freelance)
description:
This opportunity is only for candidates currently residing in the specified country. Your location may affect eligibility and rates. Please submit your resume in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

What We Do

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI. The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real‑world expertise from across the globe.

About The Role

Mindrift is looking for passionate freelance contributors to join the Tendem project ( to help build the future of hybrid agents — where human expertise and AI capabilities work hand in hand. As an AI Agent Assistant, you'll collaborate with large language models (LLMs) that handle repetitive tasks, while you bring the nuance, judgment, and creativity required to deliver high‑quality results. In this role, you won't just review what AI produces — you'll work alongside it, shaping and completing outputs so they are accurate, reliable, and ready for real‑world application. Your day‑to‑day may range from fact‑checking a scientific claim to curating a dataset, conducting market research, or refining sales leads. This flexible, part‑time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with backgrounds in research, editing, analysis, or related fields who are excited by the possibilities of human‑AI collaboration. Your contributions will directly influence how AI systems learn, evolve, and support industries worldwide.

This is a freelance role for a project, and your typical tasks may include:

  • Your mission - deliver well‑reasoned, accurate, and clearly written outputs backed by credible sources.
  • Conduct thorough web research to verify information and collect supporting evidence.
  • Collaborate with large language models (LLMs) and internal tools, using them as copilots to complete complex tasks.
  • Design and refine prompts to guide AI toward higher‑quality results.
  • Apply best practices for working with LLMs, understanding both their strengths and limitations.
  • Adapt quickly between diverse annotation, research, and analysis tasks while following detailed guidelines.

How To Get Started

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you'll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.

Requirements

  • You are currently enrolled in or completed a Bachelor's and/or Master's degree in any field.
  • You have professional and/or educational experience in data annotation, demonstrate a deeper‑than‑user‑level interest in AI, and possess intellectual breadth and curiosity.
  • You are skilled in web searching, fact‑checking, intent‑checking, able to work with LLMs and have great attention to detail.
  • Your level of English is upper‑intermediate (B2) or above.
  • You are ready to learn new methods, able to switch between tasks and topics quickly and sometimes work with challenging, complex guidelines.
  • Our freelance role is fully remote so you just need a laptop, internet connection, time available and enthusiasm to take on a challenge.

Benefits

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $9/hour depending on your skills, experience, location and project needs.
  • Take part in a part‑time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio.
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

description:

A Iguatemi detém participação em 14 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 3 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. ⛳ MISSÃO DO CARGO

Responder pela execução de manutenções preventivas, preditivas e corretivas e manobras em instalações elétricas com baixa e alta tensão em todas as cabines e subestações do Shopping (Manobras e manutenções em média e alta tensão limitadas aos profissionais com formação técnica em elétrica ou eletrotécnica). Responder pela operação e manutenção dos equipamentos do sistema de refrigeração (chilers, torres de resfriamento, fan coils e sistemas de dosagem de produtos químicos de água gelada), realizando também atendimento emergencial nas lojas, garantindo adequado padrão no sistema de ar condicionado do empreendimento. Responsável pela operação e execução da manutenção dos sistemas de iluminação do shopping. Responsável pela manutenção dos sistemas de automação predial, refrigeração, sistemas de alarme e monitoramento e apoio nos equipamentos de estacionamento. Apoiar a operação e execução da manutenção geral do shopping, como: civil, pintura, marcenaria, tubulação, bombas de água, reservatórios de água potável e pluvial. O Técnico de Manutenção é responsável pela manutenção preventiva e corretiva das instalações elétricas, verificação rotineira da iluminação, sistema de ar condicionado, funcionamento das bombas de recalque, identificar problemas no sistema de climatização, atender emergencialmente às lojas com problemas elétricos ou de ar condicionado, responsável pela organização e limpeza da CAG, CM's, SE e oficina de Manutenção.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como ?

  • Executar manutenção preventiva no sistema elétrico do condomínio, que é compreendido por: baixa / alta tensão, quadros de distribuição geral, quadros de iluminação do mall, centros de medição, geradores e sistema de telefonia entre outros. Compreende como parte deste processo o devido preenchimento das solicitações de manutenção geradas pelo sistema de gerenciamento.
  • Executar manutenção corretiva no sistema elétrico sempre que os componentes apresentarem falha ou perda de rendimento, vindo a comprometer o funcionamento das operações do shopping.
  • Inspeções rotineiras nas áreas como cm's, casas de bombas, casas de máquinas de elevador, casas de máquinas de escadas rolantes, corredores do mall, área externa do mall e coberturas a fim de detectar oportunidades de manutenção. Organização da oficina de manutenção.
  • Operar e executar manutenção nos equipamentos de ar condicionado realizando ronda para verificar as áreas técnicas, verificar o livro de ocorrências, verificar nível de água das torres, verificar nível de água da caixa d'água, verificar funcionamento das bombas, verificar nível de óleo dos equipamentos e partir a máquina. Realizar a manutenção preventiva nos equipamentos conforme plano e manutenção corretiva sempre que necessário.
  • Monitorar o sistema de ar condicionado por meio de levantamento de dados de temperatura externa, temperatura da água gelada, umidade do ar, temperatura de bulbo ámido, impressões de gráficos e arquivamento das informações.

OBSERVAÇÕES

  • Curso Técnico em Eletrotécnica, elétrica, eletrônica e refrigeração

title: Enfermeiro Marítimo
description:
Descrição

Você está em busca de um desafio no setor offshore? O Enfermeiro Marítimo (ENF) será responsável por prestar cuidados de saúde e promover o bem-estar da tripulação nas embarcações. Local da vaga: Offshore.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Suporta todos os aspectos do Sistema de Gestão de Segurança nas operações do dia-a-dia;
  • Manter a farmácia, enfermaria e isolamento em perfeitas condições, ordem, limpeza e higiene;
  • Comunicar, por escrito, ao Comandante, através do Imediato, sempre que um tripulante tenha estado internado na enfermaria de bordo, bem como a existência de pessoa acometida de doença infecciosa ou sujeita a notificação obrigatória, providenciando, nestes casos, as providências necessárias prevenir a propagação da doença;
  • Siga rigorosamente as instruções do Departamento Nacional de Saúde ou outra autoridade governamental;
  • Examinar diariamente, os géneros provenientes dos armazéns e câmaras frigoríficas de bordo, para preparação dos alimentos;
  • Acompanhar, obrigatoriamente, a entrada do material alimentar a bordo, a fim de verificar a sua qualidade, comunicando ao Comandante, através do Imediato, quaisquer irregularidades, incluindo o estado dos locais onde se encontram armazenados os alimentos;
  • Fiscalizar o embarque dos tripulantes e a sua entrada a bordo, não permitindo o embarque de todos os que sejam portadores de doença infecciosa ou outra, que pela sua natureza não possam ser tratados a bordo;
  • Acompanhar o Comandante durante a inspeção de saúde em todas as instalações a bordo;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre o estado de saúde dos tripulantes e dos impossibilitados de permanecer a bordo, comunicando ao Comandante, por meio do Imediato;
  • Atender, a qualquer tempo, os acidentes ocorridos a bordo, prestando os socorros necessários à vítima e, como Técnico de Enfermagem do Trabalho Offshore, classificar as lesões;
  • Comparecer à visita das autoridades sanitárias, em portos nacionais e estrangeiros;
  • Prestar informações ao Comandante, por meio do Imediato, sobre as condições sanitárias a bordo;
  • Acompanhar serviços de controle de pragas (todos os tipos), fumigação, desinfecção e descontaminação a bordo;
  • Permanecer em posto médico a bordo durante o horário previamente estabelecido pelo Comandante;
  • Manter devidamente inventariado todo o material de saúde (equipamentos cirúrgicos, medicamentos e utensílios de farmácia), material de primeiros socorros, zelando pela sua conservação e contabilizando as faltas encontradas;
  • Solicitar medicamentos e materiais necessários, encaminhando-os ao Comandante, por meio do Imediato;
  • Apresentar lista do material de saúde que houver a bordo, que deverá ser entregue às autoridades de cada porto;
  • Apoiar o Mestre, o Médico do Trabalho e a Enfermeira do Trabalho Onshore tudo o que for necessário.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior em Enfermagem, com registro ativo no COREN;
  • CIR Válida;
  • TBS-1 e EBCP Válidos;
  • Experiência comprovada no segmento marítimo;
  • Vivência em atendimento de urgência e emergência.

The Role

We’re seeking a highly analytical and performance‑driven User Acquisition Manager to lead and scale paid acquisition efforts across Mode Mobile's consumer app portfolio. What You Bring to the Team

    • Curious: You focus on the "why," learn and expand your knowledge, explore new ideas, and generally make things better. You’re a lifelong learner with a thirst for knowledge and a constant desire to improve.
    • Thorough: Your work is thoughtful, impactful, timely, accurate, and complete. You pay attention to detail, are meticulous, and ensure quality work and compliance.

Why Join Mode Mobile

  • Work with a top‑tier, globally distributed engineering and growth team

  • Join a mission‑driven culture where ownership is real, ideas move fast, and impact is visible
  • Grow within a fast‑growing company backed by strong leadership and continued investment

What We Are Offering

A pessoa Engenheira de Inteligência Artificial irá desenvolver, implementar e otimizar soluções de Inteligência Artificial baseadas em modelos de linguagem (LLMs), atuando na integração de tecnologias de IA em produtos e processos da empresa. Será responsável por projetar arquiteturas RAG, desenvolver estratégias de prompt engineering, implementar pipelines de dados para IA, e garantir a integração eficiente de LLMs em aplicações corporativas, visando gerar valor através de automação inteligente, melhoria da experiência do usuário e suporte à tomada de decisão baseada em IA.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver, implementar e manter aplicações de IA baseadas em modelos de linguagem, integrando LLMs em produtos e processos da empresa através de APIs, frameworks e arquiteturas adequadas, garantindo funcionalidade, performance e experiência do usuário;
  • Projetar e implementar sistemas RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) que combinem recuperação de informação com geração de linguagem, incluindo ingestão de documentos, chunking, embeddings, indexação em vector databases e orquestração de pipelines de recuperação e geração;
  • Desenvolver, testar e otimizar prompts para diferentes casos de uso, implementando técnicas avançadas de prompt engineering (chain-of-thought, few-shot learning, role-playing, etc.) para maximizar a qualidade das respostas e minimizar custos de API.;
  • Integrar modelos de linguagem em produtos existentes e novos sistemas da empresa, garantindo compatibilidade, escalabilidade e manutenibilidade, trabalhando em colaboração com equipes de desenvolvimento de software e arquitetura;
  • Monitorar, otimizar e gerenciar o consumo de APIs de modelos de linguagem, implementando estratégias de caching, seleção de modelos adequados para cada caso de uso, e técnicas de redução de custos sem comprometer qualidade;
  • Garantir que as aplicações de IA sigam princípios de IA responsável, implementando controles de segurança contra ataques (prompt injection, jailbreaking), garantindo privacidade de dados sensíveis, mitigando bias e assegurando transparência e explicabilidade das soluções.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Matemática Aplicada, Estatística ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pós-Graduação, MBA ou especialização em Inteligência Artificial, Machine Learning, Data Science ou áreas correlatas;
  • Sólida experiência em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Experiência prática com modelos de linguagem (LLMs: GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, etc) e aplicações de IA;
  • Experiência prática em desenvolvimento de aplicações usando APIs de LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Azure OpenAI, etc);
  • Experiência em implementação de arquiteturas RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation);
  • Experiência em prompt engineering e otimização de prompts;
  • Experiência com frameworks de desenvolvimento de IA (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack, etc.);
  • Vivência em projetos de integração de IA em produtos ou processos de negócio
  • Inglês - Avançado/Fluente

description:

your work makes a difference.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

Sobre nós: A Missão da Baxter

Você experimentará um senso de propósito em toda a organização, sabendo que nosso trabalho melhora os resultados de milhões de pacientes.

title: Academic Coordinator
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The UBMS Program Coordinator fosters a learning environment that encompasses academic achievement and college preparation that centers around STEM related fields. The coordinator promotes the vision and skill level for successful graduation at the secondary level and success with college matriculation and post-secondary completion.

Supervisory Authority

The Program Coordinator will supervise approximately 3-12 wage employees to include tutors, teachers, and counselors.

Nature And Scope

The Program Coordinator is responsible for facilitating the planning, implementation, and evaluation of the various components of the Upward Bound Mathematics and Science (UBMS) program which falls under the TRIO Programs with the Department of Education. The UBMS program is designed to strengthen the math and science skills of participating students. The goal of the program is to help students recognize and develop their potential to excel in science, technology and mathematics to encourage them to pursue postsecondary degrees in STEM disciplines. The Upward Bound Math and Science program at Howard University serves 52 students from selected schools in DC and Prince George’s County in grades 9 through 12. TRIO Programs are located within the School of Education and the Program Coordinator for Upward Bound Mathematics and Science reports directly to the Director of the UBMS Program. This is a grant position that is fully funded until August 31,2027. The grant can be renewed for 5-year intervals at the conclusion of the current grant period.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Coordinating with target high school staff in Washington, DC and Prince George’s County to continually recruit and retain 52 program participants each year.
  • Assist in the identification, recruitment and selection of project participants.
  • Planning, coordinating, and implementing the program's services, including Saturday Academy sessions during the academic year and 6-week summer program for each cohort.
  • These services include: academic instruction and tutoring, SAT & ACT preparation, career exploration, financial literacy education, cultural enrichment, community service, assistance completing college admissions and financial aid applications, and on-campus residential programs.
  • Maintaining documentation of services in electronic database and participant files.
  • Assisting in the hiring, training, supervision, and evaluation of summer instructors, tutors and summer residential staff as well as student volunteers.
  • Engaging with other UBMS staff members to provide formative assessment and continuous improvement of program delivery.
  • Assisting Program Director with preparation and submission of evaluations and reports, including the Department of Education Annual Performance Report
  • Developing and nurturing partnerships with faculty and staff of Howard University and DCPS and PGCPS School districts to enhance the program's services.
  • Coordinate and supervise the monthly Saturday Academic Sessions and Summer Component activities.
  • Coordinate and supervise college counseling sessions throughout the academic year.
  • Track senior participants' college and scholarship applications submissions and provide assistance where needed.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Knowledge and understanding of student development
  • Commitment to student growth
  • Excellent interpersonal skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to be creative and initiate positive impact
  • Ability to work individually and as a team member
  • Strong time management skills
  • Vibrant and Innovative

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, science, engineering, psychology, education, school counseling or another related field. Experience working with underserved youth population (ages 13-21). Strong classroom management skills

Some evening and weekend hours required during the academic year, and extended hours during the summer component.

Preferred Requirements

  • Master’s degree in education, social work, counseling or related fields
  • Knowledge of student development
  • Prior TRIO experience
  • Ability to effectively design math and science curriculum
  • Demonstrated ability to organize and conduct intensive science enrichment activities.
  • 2 years or more experience working with youth

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$52,000-62,000

About The Job

At Alignerr, we partner with the world’s leading AI research teams and labs to build and train cutting‑edge AI models. What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years working with IAM, SSO, or enterprise identity platforms
  • Familiarity with RBAC, least‑privilege models, and access review processes
  • Understanding of how identity failures occur and how attackers exploit them

  • Freelance perks: autonomy, flexibility, and global collaboration

title: ANALISTA DE SUPORTE - BASE ADMINISTRATIVA
description:
Descrição da vaga

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Instalar e manter os sistemas informatizados, identificar e resolver problemas, realizar modificações nas instruções de operação em vigor e adaptar, a fim de prover suporte técnico na sua área de responsabilidade.

  • Prestar atendimento de suporte aos usuários internos e externos, a fim de soluciona-los;
  • Realizar atendimento de chamados através de telefone, sistema de chamados ou e-mail, garantindo o registro de todas as ocorrências;
  • Acompanhar o suporte prestado por empresas terceirizadas e implantações de novas Unidades;
  • Realizar controle para distribuição e compra de periféricos, tais como: mouse, teclado, estabilizador, etc.;
  • Realizar cotação para contratação de serviços relacionados à Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Elaborar especificações técnicas para a compra de itens relacionados à Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Acompanhar disponibilidade de serviços de telefonia, CFTV e ponto eletrônico, bem como acionar os prestadores de serviço sobre a manutenção dos mesmos;
  • Administrar e realizar o controle de usuários do Active Directory;
  • Instalar e solucionar problemas de impressoras em rede, garantindo o bom funcionamento;
  • Detectar defeitos e auxiliar na correção de instalação de softwares, garantindo o bom funcionamento dos aplicativos;
  • Prestar assistência no suporte aos usuários nos aspectos de hardware e software, envolvendo a montagem de computadores, reparos e configurações, a fim de evitar que ocorram problemas;
  • Efetuar instalação de Sistema Operacional (Windows), instalação de impressoras em rede e realizar instalação e configuração de softwares (Pacote Microsoft Office, navegadores, sistemas ERP), a fim de facilitar o processo de trabalho dos usuários;
  • Instalar, treinar e dar suporte a aplicativos desenvolvidos pela empresa e/ou aplicativos de terceiros;
  • Configurar computadores em rede e realizar a manutenção da estrutura física de computadores, garantindo os acessos aos recursos de rede;
  • Apoiar profissionais da equipe de TI nas atividades relacionadas à Tecnologia da Informação, garantindo o bom andamento dos trabalhos;
  • Organizar e receber os equipamentos no estoque de TI testando e selecionando peças para utilização no parque de equipamentos de TI, garantindo que os mesmos atendam os requisitos técnicos;
  • Instalar e configurar Antivírus e Anti-Spyware, a fim de prevenir e remover vírus, trojans e spywares, etc;
  • Administrar servidores de impressão, antivírus e serviços de e-mail corporativo, a fim de garantir o bom funcionamento dos serviços;
  • Efetuar instalação, substituição de hardware, instalação de drivers, corrigir problemas de conflito de hardware e realizar manutenção preventiva em servidores, garantindo o bom funcionamento;

  • Configurar e-mail através de gerenciador de e-mail Outlook, utilizando servidores POP, SMTP e IMAP, a fim de facilitar a comunicação entre os funcionários da empresa;
  • Instalar e Monitorar o funcionamento de Servidores Windows ou Linux, a fim de manter o bom funcionamento e desempenho dos sistemas;
  • Filtrar e direcionar chamados de suporte técnico;
  • Efetuar abertura de chamado e acompanhar manutenção nos links de internet das operadoras responsáveis;
  • Executar rotinas de backup de dados dos usuários;
  • Atender a todos os princípios e critérios de conduta contidos no Manual de Conformidade Administrativa - Políticas e Princípios de Integridade da SPDM;
  • Executar as atribuições determinadas pela Instituição a respeito das práticas a serem tomadas em relação à proteção de dados pessoais LGPD;
