About the Business Unit

M3 Global Research, part of M3 Inc., provides the most comprehensive and highest quality market research recruitment and support services available to the industry with relationships reaching respondents in more than 70 countries worldwide.

M3 Global Research maintains ISO 26362 and 27001 certifications with the highest quality data collection and project management capabilities that cover the spectrum of quantitative and qualitative techniques utilized today. M3 services incorporate all of the most advanced statistical and attitudinal methodologies allowing clients to provide world-class offerings and support services to their end-client customers throughout multiple industry sectors.

Job Description

The Expert NetworkProject Coordinator assists the Client Service team with day-to-day management of market research studies, to ensure all projects successfully complete on time, within the budget and in accordance with the client specs, while meeting and exceeding client expectations.

This position is one of the key team members in the execution of the quantitative/qualitative projects, and is responsible for field management and sample strategies, and will be accountable for coordinating with respondents, vendors, and clients. They will assist with the set-up of the study and other project requirements as needed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and control sampling and fieldwork, including screener review for allocated projects.
  • Execute end to end project related tasks which could include (but not exclusively) link setup, link testing, languages requests, desk research, quality/audit checks, set up and delivery of study invitations, manage exclusion lists, M3 Wallet approvals, invoicing and cost reconciliation.

  • Host market research pretest/pilot interviews for clients, and ensure interviews are conducted on time and as planned. This will require direct client interactions.
  • Build, update and track customized fielding plans for all projects as needed.
  • Proactively seek alternative fieldwork strategies and find solutions to address response rates and costs on each project.

  • Support PMs with invoicing ensuring that projects are closed and ready for invoicing in a timely manner.
  • Alert the Project Manager of a project when a fieldwork strategy is failing or getting off track or there is a quality concern and work together to find alternative solutions.
  • Design and request multichannel recruitment methodologies for allocated projects, which could include (but not exclusively) email campaigns, calling, desk research, text messages, online advertisement, referral schemes, forums, blogs, patient groups and associations networking and social media.
  • Scheduling respondents for market research interviews, including creating the scheduler in the system, communication with respondents, coordinating shared moderator schedules, manual entry in MR system and moderator scheduling platforms.

Qualifications

  • Ability to work autonomously and in a team environment to successfully meet study specific and departmental objectives
  • Self-motivated and able to (re)prioritize tasks throughout the workday
  • Exceptional time management, organizational skills, attention to detail and ability to multitask
  • Fluent in English

Description

  • Manage and execute waste activities, classification, reporting and permitting requirements.
  • Execute waste and surface water site inspections.

The Environmental Specialist will assist in implementation and enforcement of standards and policies to support environmental and regulatory compliance and provide guidance for operations, maintenance and construction teams.

The Environmental Assurance and Protection team protects Amazon businesses and supports the needs of our customers by proactively mitigating environmental regulatory risks and protecting the environment.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree.

  • Knowledge of federal, state and municipal regulations.
  • Experience engaging with Regulatory Agencies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Realizar testes de carga, failover e redundância em enlaces críticos;
  • Operar e gerenciar ferramentas de segurança, como: Endpoint Security, NGFW, PAM, WAF, Cloud Email Security, NAC, DNS Security, de acordo as diretrizes do CISO;
  • Monitorar e responder a alertas de segurança de rede, incidentes e vulnerabilidades, em colaboração com o time de Cyber Service;
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo evidências de controles e conformidade (LGPD, SUSEP, SOX);

description:
Result of Service

  • The Senior Technical Advisor reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under this Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat’s operational and technical teams.
  • Work Location: São Paulo, SP, Brazil
  • Expected duration: Six (6) months**

Background

That the main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all, within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean - ROLAC - is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis in developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. As part of a partnership with the Municipality of São Paulo, the project includes the elaboration of the Municipal Solid Waste Plan and the Municipal Sanitation Plan. To properly implement the project, a Senior Technical Advisor is required to ensure a good execution of the work programme. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Senior Technical Advisor reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her.

Responsibilities

  • Offering technical support for the work developed by the UN-Habitat and São Paulo’s Municipality teams.
  • Assisting in identifying complementary studies and proficiencies necessary for the technical work and drafting terms of reference for consultants.
  • Providing technical guidance for the diagnosis, solution study, and action plan of the Sanitation Plan.
  • Guiding analyses and formulating guidelines related to sanitary sewage, particularly in isolated communities and vulnerable settlements in São Paulo.
  • Defining aspects the Municipal Sanitation Plan should focus and formulating guidelines for sustainability and climate change adaptation.
  • Offering technical support on how to localize and shape international agreements and frameworks, such as the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, the New Urban Agenda, presenting ideas on how to implement these agendas in the Municipal Sanitation Plan.
  • Supporting the revision of technical content prepared by the project team.
  • Supporting project risk anticipation and mitigation, including relevant challenges or omissions and other situations that could affect project development and implementation.
  • Providing information for the systematization and exchange of good practices and experiences with other offices in the region and with divisions at headquarters.
  • Ensuring that technical activities are aligned with the quality expectations of UN-Habitat and partners.
  • Contributing to the exchange of information and providing input for product development both internally and externally to the project.
  • Participating in meetings and conferences organized by partners to strengthen the project's position and presence in the Municipality of São Paulo.
  • Completing all courses and training activities indicated by the supervisor, including the BSAFE security course from UNDSS, to be accredited during the first month of employment, and familiarizing oneself with United Nations security mechanisms.

Outputs/Work Assignment

The Senior Technical Advisor will support the implementation of the above-mentioned initiative. The consultant shall be paid a monthly allowance, upon presentation and approval by the Head of Brazil Office of monthly activities’ report.

Qualifications / Special Skills

Education Required:

  • ​Bachelor's Degree in Sanitation Engineering, Environment Engineering, Civil Engineering, Urban Studies or related fields.
  • Postgraduate Degree (Lato Sensu or Stricto Sensu) in Sanitation Engin

title: HSS & Signalling Engineer
description:
Company Overview

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider, delivering global connectivity solutions to enterprises and consumers. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform - including its own owned and operated global mobile core network, fully fledged in-house developed eSIM technology, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses - 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide.

We serve many of the world's leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo-banks, global fast moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally, enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.

1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues in 2025 exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million, we generate strong cash flows to fund our growth allowing us to continuously invest in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass-consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose-built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own aspirations to offer telecommunications services to their clients.

Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs, Hakan Koçand Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications. We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.

About the Team

As a Network Engineering member, in the Signalling functional area, you will be responsible for proposing, analysing, and defining the requirements for new and existing services and systems related to the signalling routing area and subscriber data management systems under the responsibility of the functional area. Prepare, design, test and provide new solutions or product changes of the already existing portfolio. Define and support the technology evolution roadmap for the systems under the functional area. Participate and support the other functional areas in cross functional projects.

About the Role

  • Collaboration with other Network teams in defining and managing the projects for delivery of new solutions
  • Project delivery, network design, integration, and migration strategy definition. Collaboration with other relevant departments and responsible for end-to-end delivery
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Creation of technical documentation (HLD's, LLD's, WO's, etc.) and maintain it over the lifecycle of the solutions
  • Perform implementations in live environment and understand end-to-end system testing requirements
  • Follow-up and define quality and performance indicators
  • Capacity and performance analysis, reporting and improvement solution definition
  • Service & resource configuration definition and implementation on requested systems
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and address design issues for future products or technologies
  • Maintain close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers
  • Elaborate and manage the process for change requests to current partners to meet network necessities
  • Control the network elements roadmap and be responsible for necessary software/hardware upgrades during component lifecycle
  • Generate and implement process improvements, including cross-team processes
  • Document the existing technology portfolio and propose recommendations for improvements and/or alternatives

Requirements

About You

  • Proven experience implementing live solutions on mobile telecom (GSM, UMTS, LTE, IMS), networks design, capacity management, engineering and architecture
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, GSMA, ITU standards and specifications
  • Experience designing, testing and operating signalling network functions, including STPs, DEA/DRAs and HLR/HSS
  • Experience defining, establishing and maintaining signalling interconnects, SIGTRAN and DIAMETER based, using SCTP multi-homing
  • Experience with HLR/HSS, subscriber profiles, subscriber repositories and respective reference interfaces
  • Knowledge of IMS architecture, including Application Servers and interaction with profile repositories
  • Experience in mobile services charging (online). Knowledge and experience of Ro, Gy, Gx interfaces
  • Knowledge and experience with signalling protocols and routing including M3UA, M2PA, DIAMETER, as well as upper layer protocols such as MAP, CAMEL, Sh, Cx
  • Knowledge of 5G SA networks, from a signalling (SCP and SEPP) and AUSF/UDM/UDR perspective
  • Experience with protocol analyser tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot network error/problem for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape
  • English proficiency mandatory; other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice-to-haves

  • +3 years working on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks
  • Previous experience with Nokia, Oracle, HPE products

Benefits

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses — to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Extended parental leave — 180 days maternity leave and 20 days paternity leave
  • Daycare allowance — provided to mothers with children under 3 years old, R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities — Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure — Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team — From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly be exposed to talented and driven individuals
  • Dynamic Work Environment — Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
  • Professional Development — Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field
  • International Experience — Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
  • Open Communication Culture — Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
  • Get Things Done Attitude — Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer; we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

Somos um Grupo formado por marcas que possuem mais de 45 anos de experiência na área da saúde, e estamos presentes nos estados do Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo realizando mais de 456 mil consultas anuais e cuidando da vida de mais de 100 mil pacientes. Nossa identidade foi construída equilibrando o foco em pessoas com uma gestão eficiente, por isso, valorizamos profissionais que sejam curiosos, acolhedores, que tenham calor humano, que transmitam confiança, mas que também sejam eficientes, ágeis, assertivos, orientados a resultados e processos.

Somos movidos pelo propósito de criar um Brasil ativo e sem dor, transformando relações na saúde, oferecendo um ecossistema de excelência a pacientes com doenças musculoesquelético e de terapia assistida.

Estamos em transformação e buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte da nossa história, mas para trabalhar conosco você precisa se reconhecer nos nossos valores:

FOCO NAS PESSOAS

Nossos valores

Pessoas são o nosso DNA: Somos justos nas relações com os pacientes, colegas de trabalho, parceiros e prestadores de serviço. Incentivamos sonhos e valorizamos as pessoas por suas competências.

Simplificamos para fazer bem feito: Antecipamos os problemas e buscamos realizar as atividades da forma mais eficiente, agindo de imediato e de forma coordenada com foco na solução.

Queremos mais: Buscamos incansavelmente a evolução, valorizando feedbacks e nos preocupando em sempre entregar a melhor experiência.

Empoderamos as pessoas: Somos proativos para solucionar problemas e buscar oportunidades, assumimos responsabilidade pelas atividades exercidas, sem transferi-la para outros.

Se você quer fazer a diferença, achou o lugar certo! Venha fazer história com a gente! #SomosVitus #PorUmaVidaSemDor

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Recolher o lixo da unidade;

  • Zelar pelo pedido e conservação dos materiais da limpeza.

description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat family relocation package.

Overview

We are seeking an operational auditor with substantial auditing or operational experience in Upstream or Downstream to join Internal Auditing Organization.

The Internal Auditing is responsible for helping organizations to accomplish their objectives by bringing a systematic and disciplined approach to evaluate and improve the effectiveness of the organization’s risk management, control, and governance processes.

Your primary role will be to lead and oversee the audit team while serving as the primary liaison for clients, ensuring strong relationships and high-quality delivery throughout the engagement.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Establish the objective and scope of the audit engagement.
  • Identify key risks and controls within the business and operational processes under review.
  • Develop comprehensive risk-based audit programs.
  • Responsible for the audit team and will be overseeing assistant auditors.
  • Discuss concerns and issues with the audit client, draft field memorandums, and update client and Internal Auditing Management on progress of the audit.
  • Execute risk-based audit procedures in alignment with company policies and international standards.
  • Deliver presentations to client management at the audit opening and closing meetings.
  • Provide on-the-job training and mentoring to less experienced staff.
  • Evaluate the performance and capabilities of the assisting staff auditors.
  • Provide assurance and consulting activities on internal controls as requested.
  • As a successful candidate, you will hold a bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, engineering, or another related field; an advanced degree is a plus.
  • You will have a minimum of 7 years of experience in auditing, engineering, or plant operations within the oil and gas industry or from one of the Big Four Auditing firms (Deloitte, PwC, EY and KPMG)
  • You should hold at least one professional certification, such as the Certified Internal Auditor, Certified Public Accountant, Chartered Accountant, or a similar professional credentials.
  • You must demonstrate excellent oral and written communication skills in the English language and excellent presentation and interpersonal skills.
  • You should be flexible to travel within the Kingdom and/or outside the Kingdom to conduct audit and consulting engagements.

Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer. With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

A Estratégia Saúde da Família consiste em uma reorientação do modelo assistencial, realizada mediante a implantação de equipes multiprofissionais em Clínicas de Saúde da Família. Estas equipes ficam responsáveis pelo acompanhamento de um número definido de famílias de áreas geográficas delimitadas, atuando com ações de prevenção e promoção à saúde dessa comunidade.

As equipes da ESF são compostas por Médico Generalista ou Médico de Família e Comunidade, Enfermeiro, Auxiliar ou Técnico de Enfermagem e Agentes Comunitários de Saúde (ACS).

Também há equipe de Saúde Bucal, composta por cirurgião-dentista generalista ou especialista em saúde da família, auxiliar e/ou técnico em Saúde Bucal.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Realizar atendimento na Estratégia Saúde da Família, conforme as diretrizes da Secretaria Municipal da Saúde e protocolos existentes. Realizar assistência à população sob o âmbito da promoção e proteção da saúde, prevenção de agravos, diagnóstico, tratamento, reabilitação e manutenção da saúde individual, coletiva e incluindo ações no domicilio. Realizar interface com a Rede Assistencial à Saúde, atuando de forma integral na coordenação do cuidado, através de ações que facilitem o acesso, integralidade, longitudinalidade, resolutividade e a participação da comunidade nos Serviços de Saúde.

Descrição da vaga

A Globo é feita de gente que quer fazer diferente, fazer junto, fazer o futuro. As oportunidades de novos negócios também trazem a chance e o desafio de construirmos novos times data-driven e que coloquem o consumidor no centro das nossas decisões.

Sobre a área

O time de Marketing Insights e Martech é uma frente de tecnologia e analítica dentro do marketing dos produtos digitais da Globo (Globoplay, Premiere, Telecine, Cartola, GE, G1 etc). Estudam o comportamento dos usuários (assinantes ou não), hábitos e interações com a plataforma e canais de comunicação. Respondem também pelas predições e acompanhamentos das vendas, custo por aquisição, investimento em mídias online e offline, além de dados de cancelamento dos assinantes. Além disso, são responsáveis por toda operação de envio das comunicações e gestão das ferramentas de CRM e mídia.

A área de Growth é responsável por acelerar o crescimento sustentável dos produtos digitais da Globo. Atuando no planejamento, execução e otimização das campanhas de mídia online e CRM com foco em performance, eficiência de investimento e aprendizado contínuo.

Diversidade : Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como será seu dia a dia

O trabalho consiste em limpar, transformar e modelar dados brutos em informações consumíveis para a tomada de decisões estratégicas. Durante o processo de obtenção dos dados brutos até a disponibilização dos dados limpos e transformados, além de construir tabelas e análises posteriores para relatórios, dashboards e apresentações pontuais.

Requisitos e qualificações

Do que você precisa

  • Construir pipelines de dados aplicando lógica de negócios, escolhendo níveis de agregação, agrupando e transformando campos, verificando a qualidade e limpando os dados;
  • Organizar e modelar as camadas de dados, fornecendo uma estrutura concisa que permita geração de análises e levantamento de KPIs;
  • Desenvolvimento de soluções self-service de dados;
  • Realizar análises exploratórias;
  • Construir, produtizar, avaliar e dar manutenção a modelos de Machine Learning visando o aumento de engajamento, retenção e entendimento do comportamento dos usuários;
  • Trabalhar com times de tecnologia, engenharia e analytics;
  • Realização de testes A/B para análises e incrementabilidade;
  • Dialogar com as partes interessadas para entender suas necessidades primárias, sendo capaz de operar de forma eficaz e autônoma em várias equipes em situações de ambiguidade, apenas com direcionamento de alto nível;
  • Evangelizar a utilização de dados, ensinando e compartilhando as melhores práticas.

Conhecimentos que te destacam

  • Experiência com analytics e ferramentas para marketing digital (AppsFlyer, Comscore etc.);
  • Experiência com PySpark;
  • Experiências com ferramenta de modelagem de dados como DBT ou Dataform;
  • Experiência em marketing mix modeling (MMM).

Por que vir para Globo

Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos. Na Globo, o encontro de histórias com tecnologia move um time diverso e apaixonado por inovação. A gente tem a chance de aproximar os brasileiros, criando novas formas de se conectar com eles. Aqui, cada um faz a transformação acontecer.

Overview

We are seeking a Fraud Investigator to join the Internal Special Audits Division.

The Internal Special Audits Division is responsible for conducting highly sensitive investigations into issues involving fraud, conflicts of interest, waste, and abuse to provide the management and the Board of Directors with reports, analyses, recommendations, and information concerning the activities reviewed. The Special Audits Division also helps addressing fraud risk management across the Company with programs of awareness, policy and risk consulting, and proactive risk mitigation measures.

Your primary role is to conduct confidential investigations involving misconduct by employees and contractors, while seeking to identify and develop relevant facts.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead or support time‑sensitive investigations.

  • Become familiar with and utilize Enterprise Risk Management tools (i.e., SAP) to obtain data in support of investigations.
  • Provide fraud awareness presentations throughout the Company to varying job specialties and levels of management.
  • Liaise and coordinate with other fraud‑related stakeholder departments including Corporate Security, Law, Personnel and Labor Relations.
  • Draft timely investigative reports and verbally communicate results.
  • Provide on‑the‑job training and mentoring to less experienced staff.
  • Work independently yet effectively within a team of experienced professionals.
  • As a successful candidate, you will hold a bachelor degree in accounting, finance, human resources, law, criminology, compliance, computer. An advanced degree is a plus.
  • You will have a minimum of 10 years of experience in forensic accounting, fraud investigation, auditing, law enforcement, compliance, or a related field where you utilized and developed expert interviewing and investigative techniques.
  • You will have at least one professional certification, such as the Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), Professional Certified Investigator (PCI), Certified Compliance & Ethics Professional (CCEP), Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) and Certified Public Accountant (CPA).
  • You must demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills in English with solid presentation and interpersonal skills.
  • You should be able to quickly evaluate allegations of fraud, abuse and conflicts of interest and determine the violation of the law, regulations, or Company policy.

Aramco energizes the world economy

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer. With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Se você quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa é a sua chance. Nessa posição de Product Manager , você vai somar ao time Ads Seller que tem como objetivo cuidar de toda a jornada de inserção de anúncios da OLX, tanto para usuários privados quanto usuários profissionais.

No dia a dia você vai:

  • Contribuir no desdobramento da estratégia da empresa, alinhando objetivos claros de curto, médio e longo prazo para os times sob sua gestão;
  • Construir estratégias que gerem valor para os nossos usuários, buscando proporcionar a melhor experiência com o nosso produto e impacto no negócio;
  • Envolver o time e demais stakeholders nas tomadas de decisão sobre a estratégia de produto da tribo, a fim de captar novas perspectivas e garantir o alinhamento;
  • Assegurar a comunicação das evoluções do produto para os usuários e stakeholders internos da OLX, buscando a disseminação e sustentação das melhorias realizadas;
  • Estimular a simplicidade sobre a complexidade, garantindo a coerência e sustentabilidade de longo prazo do produto, estimulando o mindset ágil de começar pequeno e focar no aprendizado, iterando rapidamente para gerar valor contínuo para usuários e negócio;
  • Ser dono das KPIs da sua área, realizando o acompanhamento e garantindo o atingimento dos resultados;
  • Entregar resultados de alto impacto relacionados aos objetivos estratégicos do produto.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ampla experiência em gerência de produto em empresas de tecnologia;
  • Perfil data driven com skill de análise de dados;
  • Uma abordagem rigorosamente analítica e orientada por métricas para a resolução de problemas;

description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck, uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

title: Human Resource Administrator
description:
The Company

Katalyst Data Management (KDM) provides end-to-end subsurface data management solutions for the oil and gas industry. From data capture and verification to data storage and organization, to marketing data online, our specialized data services cater for small enterprises, through to large multinational and corporate data centers. KDM’s web-based iGlass services and their related controls, including system redundancy, are key differentiators in providing and maintaining high availability, 24/7 access for customers. Innovation and commitment have enabled KDM to provide excellence in both technologies and service qualities.

Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities

The Human Resources Administrator provides day-to-day administrative and operational support across core Human Resources functions in Brazil, ensuring compliance with Brazilian labor legislation (CLT), applicable collective bargaining agreements, and internal company policies. This role supports employee lifecycle processes including onboarding/offboarding, employee record maintenance, benefits administration support, recruitment coordination, HR reporting, and employee inquiry response. The HR Administrator handles confidential employee information in accordance with the Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD) and maintains accurate documentation required for audits and statutory reporting.

Tasks

  • Support the end-to-end onboarding and offboarding process, including collection and validation of mandatory personal documents, coordination of pre-employment medical examinations (ASO), and preparation/maintenance of employment documentation.
  • Maintain accurate physical and digital employee personnel files (contracts, amendments, acknowledgements, and supporting documentation) and ensure records are up to date.
  • Coordinate HR data entry, updates, and reporting in HRIS (e.g., ADP WorkforceNow or local systems) and support required submissions and recordkeeping for Brazil (e.g., eSocial data coordination as applicable).
  • Provide administrative support for benefits and statutory programs, responding to employee questions regarding benefits and leave (e.g., vacation scheduling, meal/transportation vouchers where applicable) and routing complex items to HR leadership or vendors.
  • Coordinate recruitment administration, including job postings support, interview scheduling, candidate communications, and onboarding logistics.
  • Support compliance activities by tracking key dates and documents (e.g., probationary period checkpoints, contract renewals for fixed-term hires, and required acknowledgements).
  • Assist with internal HR communications and policy administration, including distribution of policies, collection of employee acknowledgements, and maintaining policy records.
  • Partner with local stakeholders (e.g., accounting/payroll providers) to support timely processing by providing accurate employee data and documentation, while maintaining confidentiality and data privacy controls.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of HR administrative processes, templates, and checklists to increase accuracy, speed, and compliance readiness.

Compliance and Data Privacy (Brazil)

  • Work is performed in alignment with CLT requirements and any applicable collective bargaining agreements, including proper documentation of the employment relationship.
  • Maintain confidentiality and process personal data in accordance with LGPD principles (purpose limitation, necessity, security, and accountability).
  • Support accurate recordkeeping needed for statutory obligations and inspections, escalating questions to HR leadership or legal counsel as appropriate.

Skills and Knowledge

  • Working knowledge of core HR administration practices and familiarity with Brazilian Labor concepts (CLT) and HR documentation standards.
  • High attention to detail, strong organization, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Professional communication skills: English proficiency (written and verbal) required.
  • Discretion and integrity when handling confidential employee information and sensitive issues.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) and comfort learning HRIS/payroll portals.
  • Strong customer-service orientation and ability to work collaboratively with employees and cross-functional partners.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position has no supervisory responsibilities; however, it provides administrative support and guidance to employees on HR processes and directs questions to appropriate stakeholders when needed.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time position. As such, the Human Resource Administrator is eligible to participate in the regional benefits program offered to Katalyst employees.

Standard days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., with flexibility as needed to support business requirements and local timekeeping practices.

Travel

Occasional local travel may be required for this position. If an offsite meeting or errand is requested, eligible mileage reimbursement will follow company policy and applicable local guidance.

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Three (3) to five (5) years of experience in HR administration, HR operations, or a similar role.
  • Experience supporting onboarding documentation, personnel file maintenance, and benefits/employee inquiries.
  • Experience working with HRIS platforms (e.g., ADP WorkforceNow) and coordinating HR data updates and reporting. HR certification or coursework (local or international) is a plus.

Resumes can be submitted to our Career Center by visiting our Katalyst Career Center.

title: Revenue Manager
description:
Company Overview

Sofitel is a pioneering French luxury hospitality brand founded in 1964. It brings French zest and inspires heartfelt encounters to the most sought‑after destinations worldwide. By seamlessly melding local culture with French zest for life through remarkable savoir‑faire and generous service, Sofitel caters to free‑minded travelers and arts and culture aficionados who appreciate a refined and understated sense of modern luxury.

Hotel Overview

The Sofitel Rio de Janeiro Ipanema, a landmark for Sofitel in the Americas, re‑emerges as a revitalized beachfront icon where French elegance meets the vibrant Carioca lifestyle. Designed as a sanctuary of art, craftsmanship, and sensory experiences, the hotel sets a new benchmark for luxury hospitality in Rio de Janeiro. It features 172 rooms and suites with the signature Sofitel MyBed, refined art‑filled interiors, and sweeping views of Two Brothers Hill. Guests enjoy an elevated dining experience at the 22nd‑floor Chef’s Table, a rooftop infinity pool, wellness spa, Beach Club, and the exclusive Club Millésime lounge for personalized service and private check‑in. The design vision is led by Brazilian architect Patricia Anastassiadis, whose storytelling approach blends heritage, artistry, and contemporary sophistication, creating spaces that feel both meaningful and deeply connected to place. Set beneath the iconic Christ the Redeemer, Sofitel Rio de Janeiro Ipanema stands as the ultimate destination for discerning travelers where luxury meets the true soul of Rio.

Revenue Manager Responsibilities

As the Revenue Manager, you will lead the development and execution of strategic revenue initiatives designed to maximize room revenue, total hotel profitability, and market share. You will leverage strong analytical expertise and commercial acumen to drive data‑informed pricing, forecasting, and distribution decisions. Working in close collaboration with Sales, Marketing, and Operations, you will ensure optimal commercial alignment, performance optimization, and sustainable revenue growth across all segments.

Revenue Strategy & Optimization

  • Develop and implement comprehensive revenue management strategies to maximize room revenue, total hotel profitability, and market share.
  • Drive dynamic pricing strategies based on demand patterns, seasonality, booking pace, and market trends.
  • Continuously evaluate performance and adjust tactical and strategic approaches to optimize results.

Forecasting & Budgeting

  • Prepare accurate daily, weekly, and monthly forecasts using historical data, market intelligence, and forward‑looking demand indicators.
  • Actively participate in the annual budgeting process, providing strategic insights and revenue projections.
  • Conduct variance analysis and present actionable recommendations to senior management.

Distribution Channel Management

  • Oversee and optimize all distribution channels, including OTA, direct, GDS, corporate, and wholesale segments.
  • Ensure a balanced and profitable channel mix, minimizing distribution costs while maximizing net revenue contribution.
  • Monitor channel performance and implement strategies to drive direct bookings and improve channel efficiency.

Market Analysis & Competitive Benchmarking

  • Analyze market trends, competitor performance, and industry dynamics using tools such as STR reports and other market intelligence platforms.
  • Identify revenue opportunities and proactively mitigate potential risks.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of the competitive landscape to support strategic positioning.

Commercial Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Director of Commercial to align pricing strategies with promotional campaigns and sales initiatives.
  • Provide revenue guidance and analytical support for corporate, group, and MICE contract negotiations to ensure profitability.

Systems & Data Management

  • Manage revenue management systems and ensure data accuracy and integrity across PMS, CRS, RMS, and distribution platforms.
  • Leverage technology and automation tools to enhance forecasting precision and operational efficiency.

Reporting & Performance Monitoring

  • Deliver regular revenue performance reports to the General Manager and regional leadership.
  • Monitor and analyze key KPIs including RevPAR, ADR, Occupancy, GOP.
  • Translate data into strategic insights to drive informed decision‑making.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop the revenue team to achieve high‑performance standards.
  • Foster a strong data‑driven and analytical culture within the department, promoting continuous improvement and commercial excellence.

Qualifications / What You Will Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality, Business, Finance, or related field (Master’s preferred).
  • Strong knowledge of luxury hospitality market dynamics (leisure, MICE, corporate, wholesale).
  • Expertise in forecasting, pricing strategy, yield management, and distribution optimization.
  • Analytical mindset with excellent attention to detail.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and cross‑department collaboration skills.
  • Strategic thinker with hands‑on execution capability.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese.
  • Leadership experience in managing and developing high‑performing teams.

Informações adicionais

  • Express entrepreneurial spirit and leadership while embodying the French Art de Vivre.
  • Demonstrate humble excellence through a distinguished presence, refined savoir‑faire, and meticulous attention to detail (Cousu Main).
  • Be a passionate team player — warm, sociable, and genuinely caring toward others.
  • Exhibit a strong sense of luxury by creating meaningful stories, rituals, and traditions.
  • Embrace a true Francophile mindset, showing curiosity and appreciation for French language, culture, history, and cuisine.
  • Demonstrate open‑mindedness, creativity, and a spirit of innovation.
  • Act as a cultural link by engaging with local arts, gastronomy, fashion, and contemporary design.
  • Champion committed luxury with a strong sense of care and responsibility.

SOBRE A AXIA ENERGIA

A Eletrobras agora é AXIA Energia e chega como a maior empresa de energia renovável do Hemisfério Sul, responsável por 17% da capacidade de geração nacional e 37% das linhas de transmissão do Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN).

Com presença em todas as regiões do país, nosso foco é oferecer soluções completas que catalisem resultados, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do setor e transformando energia em oportunidades para pessoas, negócios e para o planeta.

Na AXIA Energia, o futuro é movido pela potência de quem acredita em transformar. Venha viver o novo com a gente!

ATENÇÃO : A AXIA Energia não cobra taxas para realização de testes, exames ou participação no processo seletivo.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver projeto e soluções de indústria 4.0 aplicadas aos Sistemas de Armazenamento de Energia de Bateria (BESS) em escala de rede, elaborando layouts conceituais, diagramas unifilares e apoiando o detalhamento do projeto, desde a arquitetura de controle e proteção até a integração ao sistema de supervisão (SCADA).
  • Definir e validar arquiteturas de comunicação para Sistemas de Armazenamento de Energia em Baterias (BESS), assegurando a interoperabilidade entre os dispositivos e sua integração às plataformas de supervisão e controle. A implementação deve contemplar protocolos industriais consolidados (como Modbus RTU/TCP, CAN, IEC 61850) e soluções orientadas à Internet das Coisas (IoT), incluindo MQTT, bem como interfaces baseadas em serviços web (APIs RESTful), garantindo robustez, escalabilidade e conformidade com requisitos de cibersegurança.
  • Elaborar arquiteturas de rede de sistemas de supervisão em cloud computing AWS, considerando medidas de segurança da informação (VPN e firewall).
  • Estabelecer diretrizes, acompanhar e avaliar ensaios de rotina, testes de fábrica, testes de campo e comissionamento de Sistemas de Armazenamento de Energia de Bateria (BESS) e de todos os equipamentos envolvidos, garantindo o correto funcionamento dentro dos padrões de operação e manutenção.
  • Realizar análise de tecnologias, produtos e fornecedores para Sistemas de Armazenamento de Energia em Baterias (BESS), visando suportar a adoção de soluções inovadoras e a definição de critérios técnicos para qualificação e seleção de possíveis parceiros.
  • Desenvolver relatórios técnicos escritos que transmitam conceitos de armazenamento de energia de bateria, casos de uso e resultados de estudos de viabilidade para o pipeline.
  • Realizar e validar dimensionamento de Sistemas de Armazenamento de Energia em Baterias (BESS), considerando suas funcionalidades e contexto dos projetos.
  • Realizar e validar simulações em software de aplicações envolvendo Sistemas de Armazenamento de Energia em Baterias (BESS).
  • Executar o desenvolvimento de planos de engenharia, especificações técnicas, estimativas de custo e documentos de construção de marcos de projeto para projetos de Sistemas de Armazenamento de Energia em Baterias (BESS).
  • Apoiar pipeline na identificação, definição e implementação de casos de uso para Sistemas de Armazenamento de Energia em Baterias (BESS) em locais centralizados e/ou distribuídos.
  • Dar suporte técnico em todas as fases dos projetos de Sistemas de Armazenamento de Energia em Baterias (BESS), como:

description:
Nossas equipes de logística estão mudando a maneira como interagimos com clientes em todo o mundo todos os dias e resolvendo alguns dos maiores desafios logísticos enfrentados não apenas pela Amazon, mas também por toda a indústria. Emerging as a pioneering French luxury hospitality brand in 1964, Sofitel brings French zest and inspires heartfelt encounters to the most sought-after destinations worldwide. Sofitel Rio de Janeiro Ipanema is a landmark for Sofitel in the Americas. The property features 172 rooms and suites with the signature Sofitel MyBed, refined art‑filled interiors, and sweeping views of Two Brothers Hill. Guests enjoy elevated dining at the 22nd‑floor Chef’s Table, a rooftop infinity pool, wellness spa, Beach Club, and the exclusive Club Millésime lounge for personalized service and private check‑in.

Job Description

We are seeking a dynamic and results‑driven Outlet Manager to lead the daily operations of our established Sel d'Ipanema Beach Club while supporting the F&B Manager in the pre‑opening development of the F&B division at Sofitel Ipanema . This role requires a hands‑on leader with strong financial acumen, leadership, operational expertise, and a passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences in an upscale hospitality environment.

  • Manage the day‑to‑day operations of Sel d'Ipanema Beach Club;
  • Ensure service excellence aligned with brand standards and guest expectations;
  • Monitor and control Food & Beverage costs, labor costs, and daily revenue performance;
  • Drive revenue growth through upselling, team training, and operational efficiency;
  • Supervise reservation flow and optimize seating capacity;
  • Maintain strict inventory control and support purchasing processes;
  • Ensure compliance with health, safety, and sanitation regulations;
  • Monitor guest satisfaction scores and online reputation;
  • Handle guest concerns promptly and professionally;
  • Support the F&B Manager in pre‑opening activities for the hotel’s outlets;
  • Assist with SOP implementation, onboarding and team training;
  • Participate in soft opening preparation and execution.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or related field;
  • Proven experience as Outlet Manager or Assistant F&B Manager in upscale or luxury hospitality;
  • Strong understanding of P&L and cost control principles;
  • Leadership skills with the ability to motivate and develop teams;
  • Commercial mindset with focus on revenue optimization;
  • Excellent communication and problem‑solving skills;
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese;
  • Ability to perform in high‑volume, fast‑paced environments;
  • Pre‑opening experience is a plus.

Additional Information

  • Express entrepreneurial spirit and leadership while embodying the French Art de Vivre;
  • Demonstrate humble excellence through a distinguished presence, refined savoir-faire, and meticulous attention to detail (Cousu Main);
  • Be a passionate team player — warm, sociable, and genuinely caring toward others;
  • Exhibit a strong sense of luxury by creating meaningful stories, rituals, and traditions;
  • Embrace a true Francophile mindset, showing curiosity and appreciation for French language, culture, history, and cuisine;
  • Demonstrate open‑mindedness, creativity, and a spirit of innovation;
  • Act as a cultural link by engaging with local arts, gastronomy, fashion, and contemporary design;
  • Champion committed luxury with a strong sense of care and responsibility.

Conheça o Modelo De Contrato Intermitente

  • A modalidade de contrato intermitente é regido pela CLT e a carteira de trabalho do empregado é assinada normalmente;
  • A prestação de serviços ocorre de forma não contínua, ou seja, o trabalhador é convocado para trabalhar quando há demanda do empregador e disponibilidade do empregado, sem uma jornada de trabalho fixa.
  • O empregado recebe apenas pelas horas efetivamente trabalhadas, sem salário fixo mensal.
  • Mesmo sendo intermitente, o trabalhador possui direitos como férias proporcionais, 13º salário, FGTS e INSS, proporcionais ao período trabalhado.

O Que Você Fará No Dia-a-dia

Um operador intermitente em um parque de turismo, desempenha atividades em diversas áreas, tem uma rotina dinâmica e variada. As principais atividades em cada um dos setores dos parques:

Restaurantes e Lanchonete/Cozinha

  • Preparação de Alimentos: Auxiliar na preparação e montagem de pratos, garantindo a qualidade e a apresentação.
  • Limpeza e Organização: Manter a cozinha limpa e organizada, lavando utensílios e mantendo a área de trabalho em conformidade com as normas de higiene.
  • Apoio ao Chef: Auxiliar o chef e a equipe de cozinha em tarefas como cortes, mise en place e controle de estoque.

Restaurantes e Lanchonete/Atendimento

  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Receber os clientes, acomodá-los e apresentar o cardápio.
  • Serviço de Alimentos e Bebidas: Servir os pedidos e garantir que os clientes tenham uma experiência agradável.

Comercial/Vendas

  • Abordagem ativa de visitantes identificando oportunidades de venda por meio de uma abordagem cordial, proativa.
  • Apresentação de produtos e serviços, oferecendo ingressos, upgrades, combos, experiências adicionais, fotos, souvenirs e demais produtos comerciais disponíveis nos atrativos.
  • Conversão de vendas: Atuar com foco em metas, buscando transformar atendimentos em vendas efetivas, sempre prezando pela experiência positiva do cliente.

O Que Você Precisa Ter

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar principalmente aos finais de semana e feriados, com possibilidade de atuar durante a semana.
  • Capacidade de desempenhar diversas funções conforme a demanda dos parques
  • Habilidade em interagir com diferentes públicos de forma clara e amigável
  • Habilidade de colaboração com outros membros da equipe para garantir um bom funcionamento das operações.
  • Comprometimento: É essencial demonstrar comprometimento e pontualidade, evitando faltas.

Local De Trabalho

Horário De Trabalho e Escala

  • A jornada de trabalho diária pode ser de 6h ou 8h.

Vem causar muito impacto positivo conosco!

description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua nos segmentos automotivo e do agronegócio, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac(AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkotruck, uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

description:
What does the job involve?

Responsible for management within one or more areas like sea surveillance, emergency preparedness, rig move operation, supply bases, helicopters, vessels, transportation, and other logístical assets. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring safe, efficient and effective utilization of these assets to support operations. This includes coordinating with internal stakeholders, such as operations and maintenance teams, to ensure that logístical assets are available and operational when needed. Contribute to the organization's ability to deliver resources and services in a risk-based, timely and reliable manner. You are utilizing your knowledge independently to solve highly complex tasks with a short to medium-term tactical impact/risk. You address key business challenges that align with Equinor's short and long-term strategy via providing specialist support to your team and others. You independently communicate within the immediate team, across other areas, and towards key stakeholders from partners or external parties. You regularly navigate conflicting agendas and may lead negotiations with senior stakeholders. You resolve challenges, deliver improvements and contribute to shaping best practices. You promote change initiatives, demonstrate flexibility to adopt new highly complex activities/ways of working and advice others. You follow and comply with safety, ethics, and compliance requirements and align with leadership expectations and company values. Full band description can be found on Insight.

What will my tasks be?

Within this position, your key tasks will be to:

  • Monitor and report on monthly Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and follow-up actions to enhance operational performance.
  • Drive initiatives aimed at improving aviation processes and procedures.
  • Review and update operational procedures periodic to ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations. Stay updated on relevant aviation legislation and ensure compliance across operations.
  • Follow up with air operator regarding maintenance planning and maintain an action log.
  • Close follow up with Flight safety department in Norway. Set up and follow up on the annual flight safety verification process to ensure adherence to safety protocols.
  • Identify cost accrual opportunities and implement reduction initiatives to optimize budget efficiency.
  • Monitor and report on fleet availability to ensure optimal operational readiness.
  • Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to enhance air traffic management and operational flow.

Here's what we expect from you

At Equinor, there are some overall qualities we regard as essential. We want you to identify with the values that guide our decisions and help us succeed and grow: open, collaborative, courageous and caring. We expect you to make safety your priority and to contribute to our zero-harm culture. And for this specific position, we are also looking for:

  • Minimum 10 years of relevant experience with aviation logistics. Bachelor’s degree preferably in Mechanical or Aeronautical Engineering or related areas.
  • At least 5 years of experience in helicopter maintenance and operations/logistics, OR similar field of study with proven experience in aviation engineering.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and in English (written and spoken).

title: Onboarding Manager - Publishers (Remote)
description:
About MonetizeMore

MonetizeMore is a global leader in ad tech, seen by 300M+ people monthly. For 16 years, we’ve achieved double-digit growth by blending proprietary AI technology with manual optimization techniques to empower publishers. We are a culture-centric, location-independent organization that values Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen, and Collaboration.

MonetizeMore offers location and schedule freedom to every one of its team members. That means that you would have the lifestyle autonomy to choose to work from anywhere in the world, during the time of day you prefer. This new-age work lifestyle would enable you to engineer your ideal lifestyle. Say goodbye to endless commutes, stuffy business attire, and the arbitrary 9 to 5 work-day. Take your life back into your hands by joining the MonetizeMore team!

What You’ll Do

As part of our Publisher Centric Team , At M2, we focus and emphasize proactive Publisher Services. As the Onboarding Manager, your role is a critical "first impression" of our organization and our ability to support our publishing partners in reaching their goals.

You will spearhead the onboarding process for new publishers, ensuring they are equipped with the right tech, knowledge, and confidence to succeed. You are not just setting up accounts you are orchestrating a "White Glove" experience that reduces time-to-value and sets the stage for long-term retention. You also pay attention to improving our systems and processes along the way to continuously improve our service to publishers.

Responsibilities

  1. Project Management & Implementation
    • Lead the Lifecycle: Expertly manage the publisher journey from Sales endorsement to "Live" status. You are the project manager for the publisher’s first 30-90 days.
    • Technical Coordination: Collaborate with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers to troubleshoot setup concerns (Header Bidding, GAM, wrappers) and ensure optimal configuration.
    • Feature Activation: Ensure all applicable M2 Tech Features are activated at launch to maximize publisher revenue immediately (KPI: Uptake %).
  2. Client-Centric Communication & Education
    • Kick-off & Strategy: Conduct kick-off calls to understand the publisher's specific business goals and align our implementation plan to meet them.
    • Ambassadorship: Act as the primary champion for M2 tools and products. Provide comprehensive walkthroughs to ensure publishers are comfortable and proficient with our platform.
    • Responsive Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for all questions during installation, providing guidance that is both technical and empathetic.
  3. Performance Analysis & Handoff
    • Performance Reviews: Conduct thorough 7-day and 30-day post-live performance reviews. Use data to demonstrate value and identify early optimization wins.
    • Seamless Transition: Manage a structured handoff to the Ad Optimizer and Customer Success Manager, ensuring no momentum is lost after the initial 30-day period.

Day-today Activities

You are the external face of MonetizeMore for our newest partners. You thrive on variety and high-energy interaction—no two days (or publishers) are exactly alike.

  • External Engagement: You will constantly meet new partners, leading high-impact kickoff calls to align our tech with their specific business goals.
  • Project Command: You project manage the entire implementation lifecycle, coordinating between the publisher and our technical teams to ensure an optimal, revenue-ready setup and accelerated scale.
  • Performance Ownership: You don't just "set it and forget it." You conduct data-driven 7-day and 30-day etc. performance reviews to prove value immediately.
  • Seamless Handoff: Once the foundation is solid, you orchestrate a smooth transfer to the account management team ensuring the relationship momentum continues uninterrupted.

How this role fits into the organization

This is a cornerstone role that is pivotal to our company’s success.

  • Strategic Impact: Reporting to the Ad Ops Team Manager, you are the architect of the "First 30 Days." Since our publishers' growth is our growth, our long-term revenue goals effectively start on your desk.
  • The "Wow" Factor: You are responsible for delivering the "White Glove" experience. You set the trajectory for retention by uncovering publisher goals early and proving that MonetizeMore is a partner, not just a vendor.
  • Bridge Builder: You act as the vital link between Sales promises and long-term Operational success, ensuring that every new client enters our ecosystem with clarity, confidence, and a setup primed for revenue generation.

Who You Are

Must Haves

  • Experience: 1+ years of experience in Programmatic sell-side advertising, Customer Onboarding, or Ad Operations.
  • Technical Knowledge: Understanding of Google Ad Manager (GAM), AdSense, Header Bidding, and Google Analytics. Experience with WordPress and debugging ad calls is a strong plus.
  • Analytical Skills: Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and data presentation tools. You can spot trends in numbers quickly.
  • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You can command a room (virtually) and manage expectations clearly.
  • Project Management: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple implementations simultaneously without dropping the ball.

Nice to Have

  • Has worked with AdSense, Google Analytics, and GAM and has extensive knowledge of Google policies and other platforms
  • Understands coding and has a strong tech background
  • Has worked with WordPress and is knowledgeable when it comes to implementing ads and debugging ad calls
  • Bilingual - Portuguese and Spanish are an extra bonus

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary : Our salary formula adjusts to your cost of living and experience.
  • Work remotely : Live and work wherever you like!
  • Flexible working hours : You have the autonomy to set your own schedule
  • Retreats : We meet in person for company get-togethers.
  • Career growth and learning opportunities

If you think you are a good fit to join our Ad Optimization , please apply on this side bar and give specific reasons what sets you apart. We hire individuals, not robots so don’t be afraid to show a little personality.

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion. Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Assistant or Associate Professor – Mathematics (AI for Radiology & Endocrinology)

The Department of Mathematics in the College of Arts and Sciences at Howard University invites applications for a full-time, tenure-track Assistant or Associate Professor position. The department seeks candidates with research expertise and teaching interests in mathematics enhanced artificial intelligence (AI), with applications to radiology, endocrinology, and related biomedical domains. The anticipated start date is August 2026. This position is part of the Provost’s Artificial Intelligence Cluster Hire Initiative and is embedded within the interdisciplinary cluster “Advancing Health through Mathematics-Enhanced AI for Radiology and Endocrinology”, jointly led by the College of Arts and Sciences and the College of Medicine. The cluster aims to strengthen university-wide research capacity by recruiting faculty whose scholarship advances mathematical foundations, modeling, and computational methodologies that support AI-driven biomedical discovery, while fostering collaboration across disciplines.

SUPERVISORY AUTHORITY

The successful candidate is expected to demonstrate a strong commitment to excellence in teaching, mentoring, and service. The faculty member will contribute to the growth of the Department of Mathematics’ research and academic programs in data science, applied mathematics, and AI, and will actively participate in interdisciplinary initiatives across the university.

Nature And Scope

From a mathematics-centered perspective, this position emphasizes the development and application of mathematical theory, statistical modeling, and computational methods that underpin modern AI and machine learning approaches in biomedical sciences. The cluster seeks to advance quantitative frameworks for imaging, inference, prediction, and decision-making in complex biological and clinical systems. The successful candidate will contribute to an interdisciplinary academic environment through research, teaching, mentorship, and collaboration.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Conduct high-quality, externally visible research in applied mathematics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence, with relevance to biology and medicine.
  • Develop and sustain an externally funded research program, including collaborative interdisciplinary projects.
  • Teach undergraduate and graduate courses in mathematics, data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence.
  • Supervise and mentor undergraduate and graduate students, postdoctoral scholars, and junior researchers.
  • Collaborate with faculty across mathematics, medicine, and related disciplines to advance AI-enabled quantitative methods for biomedical applications.

Core Competencies

The Department of Mathematics particularly encourages applicants with expertise in one or more of the following areas:

  • Mathematical Foundations of AI and Machine Learning: Optimization, statistical learning theory, inverse problems, uncertainty quantification, dynamical systems, or computational mathematics relevant to AI.
  • AI and Data-Driven Modeling in Biomedicine: Development of mathematical and computational methods for imaging, neuroscience, endocrinology, diabetes, or other data-intensive biomedical domains.
  • Interdisciplinary Research and Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to collaborate with clinicians, biologists, or engineers to develop mathematically grounded AI/ML approaches for complex biological and medical datasets.

Minimum Requirements

  • Ph.D. in Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a closely related field.
  • Strong research record in mathematics-driven AI or ML, with applications to biology or medicine, evidenced by peer-reviewed publications.
  • Demonstrated ability or clear potential to secure external research funding.
  • Evidence of excellence or strong potential in undergraduate and graduate teaching.
  • Commitment to interdisciplinary collaboration, student mentorship, and advancing diversity, equity, and inclusion in teaching and research.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Compensation Range: $135,000 - $150,000
